articleTitle: Big Data as a Management Decision-Making Tool in Digital Business Environments
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article examines the problem of using big data in the process of making managerial decisions. Approaches to the definition of the concept and main characteristics of big data are considered, the sources of big data, methods of big data analysis are revealed, the comparison of traditional management information analytics and big data analytics is given, the possibilities of using big data in the planning of functional strategies of the organization are shown, the prospects for the development of the big data market in the conditions of business digitalization are evaluated.

articleTitle: Transformation of Business Technologies into Digital Platforms and Evaluation of the Effectiveness of their Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The digital economy is one of the important components of the digital transformation of the global economy. The influence of the digital economy on all spheres of life is considered, a number of innovative digital technologies are presented that are used in modern conditions of modern business in a competitive environment. The article gave a classification of business technologies and considered their importance for the formation of digital platforms. Trends and directions of development of digital models in world practice are considered. A digital platform is an information environment that unites all market participants and simplifies their interaction using digital technologies. Modern platforms and platforms that promote different types of economic activities are transforming entire industries and different types of economic activities, thereby leading to economic growth, innovation and the development of competition. Methods for calculating the effectiveness of using digital platforms in the digital economy and society are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Risk-based Approach Methodology in Information Security Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, most companies systematically face challenges related to the loss of significant confidential information, including legally significant information, such as personal data of customers. To solve the problem of maintaining the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information, companies are increasingly using the methodology laid down in the basis of the international standard ISO / IEC 27001. Information security risk management is a process of continuous monitoring and systematic analysis of the internal and external environment of the IT environment, associated with the further adoption and implementation of management decisions aimed at reducing the likelihood of an unfavorable result and minimizing possible threats to business caused by the loss of manageability of information that is important for the organization. The article considers the problems and approaches to the development, practical implementation, and methodology of risk management based on the international standard ISO 31000 in the modern information security management system.

articleTitle: Methods of Digital Transformation of Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Introduction of digital technologies in the business models of companies is a trend of the current decade, every day the demand for digital technologies for business in the market is growing. A deep reorganization of business processes with the widespread use of digital tools for their execution, which leads to a significant increase in the effectiveness of the organization's process model for the entire product/service life cycle — is a necessary condition for ensuring competitiveness in the global market. Implementation of a management system based on well-known tools such as ERP, CRM, BPM, EDM etc. they do not fully allow you to build a proactive vertical management of the enterprise. The article considers both individual approaches and methods of digital transformation of the organization's management tools, and the general methodology for building a comprehensive digital management system that meets the requirements of international standards in the field of management systems.

articleTitle: Modeling the Clustering of Wireless Sensor Networks Using the K-means Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the development of information and communication technologies has led to the emergence of the Internet of Things. The technological basis for the implementation of the concept of the Internet of Things is wireless sensor networks. Clustering, a machine learning technique, is an effective way to extend the lifecycle and reduce power consumption of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). The article presents modeling and clustering of flying wireless sensor networks that form when a group of drones moves. The introduction of moving sensors leads to dynamic clustering of the entire system at successive times. complicating the determination of the number of individual clusters and their integration. The clustering mechanism is performed using the K-means algorithm with respect to the location of wireless stationary and flying sensors, described by coordinates x, y, and z in three-dimensional space.

articleTitle: Analysis of Approaches to Audio&visual Interaction Information Systems Creating in the Context of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The digital transformation of modern companies and structures make a problem of creating a unified information environment top relevant, including information systems of audio&visual interaction as its element. The article provides a comparative analysis of the technical characteristics and models of information systems implementation. The performed research allows us to justify the approach to creating information systems of audio-visual interaction for federal and municipal administration structures, considering goals, criteria, and restrictions intended.

articleTitle: Innovative Technologies Monitoring the State of Geographically Distributed Networks Industrial Facilities (Using the Example of Pipeline Transport)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A necessary element of the system of automated management of geographically distributed production facilities is multicriteria control of their safety. The urgency of the problem of ensuring industrial safety increases when it comes to dangerous and especially dangerous production facilities, the elimination of the consequences of accidents at which are associated with high environmental and economic damage to the state economy. The article substantiates the criteria for the analysis of scientific developments in the field under consideration. The results of the analysis of developments in the field of monitoring the state of geographically distributed production facilities by means of intelligent software and hardware complexes and systems using fiber-optic sensors, etc. are presented. Based on the justified criteria, the selection of technical solutions for the creation of a geographically distributed system for monitoring the state of production facilities of the oil and gas industry was made.

articleTitle: Digital Competence of a Foreign Language Teacher: E-learning in Work
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the formation of digital competence of a foreign language teacher in the context of modern educational policy and digital transformation of educational system. The authors substantiate the need to master this type of competence for the teachers in order to comply with the Federal State Educational Standard and the Professional Standard. They are analyzed various approaches to determining the digital competence components, and it is proposed its structure considered as the unity of value-motivational, operational-technological, communicative-cognitive, and reflexive-evaluative components. The key characteristics of the technologies used in the educational process and their classification are also considered. It is argued that the introduction of these technologies in the process of training future foreign language teachers will enhance the students' cognitive activity, positively influencing the formation of digital competence.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transport Systems: Analysis of the Current State and Prospects of Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article examines the relevance of the development and considers the advantages of using ITS. The history of ITS development in Moscow is investigated. The structural elements of ITS and their functional purpose are identified, and the main trends of development in the coming years, including through state funding, are identified. The experience of ITS implementation and operation in various regions of our country is presented.

articleTitle: A Study of Modern Risk Management Methods for Industrial Safety Assurance in the Fuel and Energy Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: To ensure the safety of fuel and energy holding companies, it is necessary to apply modern risk management methods. To improve the efficiency of complex management systems, it is important to meet risk management requirements based on the standards applied in the industry. The well-known international standards (ISO 31000, IEC 31010, ISO / IEC 27005, IEEE / ISO / IEC 16085) set new risk management requirements for any industry, including the fuel and energy one. These standards are based on different approaches which causes a discrepancy between the two versions of risk management requirements. The article provides an analysis of these two standards which have been analyzed by the risk management method applied in the fuel and energy industry. The results can be applied when improving the efficiency of complex management systems (e.g., in the study of PDCA cycle closures in the fuel and energy industry).

articleTitle: Comparing Efficiency of Outsourcing or Insourcing Digital Logistics in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The goal of the article is to investigate the influence of insourcing and outsourcing of digital logistics solutions to efficiency of a firm operating in Supply Chain 4.0 environment. Digital logistics covers digital technologies in both manufacturing planning and supply chain. Supply Chain 4.0 is an application of the Internet of Things to improve productivity and customer satisfaction. This requires the introduction of advanced robotics and advanced big data analytics in supply chain management. It is argued that depending of various reasons a firm could either develop digital logistic solutions internally or outsource it. Multicase analysis as a main research method gave an opportunity to divide main alternatives of decisions and factors justifying them. Managerial application of the paper offers trends for IT implementation and perspective business solutions based on them. Specific way to measure efficiency addressed for both insourcing and outsourcing of digital logistics solutions.

articleTitle: Integration of Quality Management Tools into a Digital Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The widespread introduction of digital technologies in all areas of the world economy imposes new requirements on the concept of universal quality management (TQM) associated with the adaptation of proven and effective tools and methods of management, control and quality improvement to the new realities of the digital management system. At this stage of the formation of the modern concept, quality management uses a large number of different methods, each of which is aimed at achieving individual target indicators achieving the goals of improving quality, meeting applicable requirements, increasing customer satisfaction, transparency of management decision-making processes, and reducing risks, but the problem of practical integration of these approaches into the digital environment of the organization has not been fully solved. The article discusses the stages and methods of digital transformation of management and quality control tools and methods for full integration into a modern management system built in accordance with the requirements of the latest editions of international standards in the field of quality, ecology and occupational safety and health.

articleTitle: Explainable Artificial Intelligence Approaches: Challenges and Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are used in many areas, for example, in finance and medicine. Every year, intelligent systems get for processing more and more data and make more and more decisions. All these decisions are exerting more and more influence on human destinies. Mistrust of fully non-human, autonomous artificial intelligence systems become the cornerstone. The key of mistrust is hidden in the lack of understanding as to why intelligent systems make this or that decision. To solve this problem, methods of explainable artificial intelligence are used. This article provides an overview of such methods and discusses the main trends in their development, as well as the implementation difficulties that one has to face during development and use.

articleTitle: Assessment of Online Learning Effectiveness by Students of Engineering and IT Degree Programs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In 2020, traditional education will face a struggle in replacing full-time education with distance teaching and learning. The findings of a study on the effectiveness of distance teaching and learning are presented in this article. The article's content is based on research conducted at the St. Petersburg Electrotechnical University “LETI.” The primary focus of the study was on full-time students of bachelor's and master's engineering and IT degree programs of the university. The results of a survey of students' satisfaction with distance learning in 2020 are described in this article. The survey's main finding is a firm determination of the most successful techniques of teaching theoretical content and practical classes over the internet. The usefulness of several remote learning monitoring strategies is also examined. The results of a comparison of senior and junior students' perceptions of distance learning practice are also presented in the paper.

Author Keywords: share of distance learning in the educational process

articleTitle: LabVIEW Application Programming Interfaces for Remote Access to Power Supply and Spectrum Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the application programming interfaces (API) for remote control of the Agilent E3631A power supply and Rohde & Schwarz FSL18 spectrum analyzer. The developed application programming interfaces can be used by students to learn the basics of measurements automation and by laboratory instructors to design laboratory stands available online.

articleTitle: Review of Existing Solutions in the Field of Real Estate and Cadastral Accounting Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today's global real estate market has been rebuilding for more than a decade under the new realities. Mass digitalization and instant access to the Internet allowed network users to get information about the object they needed as quickly as possible. The market is trying to apply all new technologies to stay relevant and competitive. The use of blockchain technology eliminates many of the third-party factors that make real estate and cadastre work impossible or difficult. B данной статье были рассмотренысуществующие решения в области недвижимости икадастра на основе технологии блокчейн: Ledger Leopard, RealBlocks, SafeChain, Bitfury Group, Lantmäteriet, Ubitquity, ChromaWay AB, Bitland, Factom, UAE solutions and other solutions.

articleTitle: Application of Additive Technology for 3D Printing of Electronic Devices as a Way to Reduce Prototyping Time
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The technology of printed electronics today is innovative, which opens up a number of advantages of prototyping electronics devices using traditional factory technology for manufacturing boards. The article discusses the practical experience of prototyping printed circuit boards on the DragonFly 2020 LDM 3D printer, allowing to significantly reduce the time of release of products to the market.

articleTitle: Innovative Methods of Spectrum Management for the Development of Promising Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The rapid development of radio communication technologies and networks, the growth of the number of radio-electronic devices used, is accompanied by a significant increase in the demand for the radio-frequency spectrum, which leads to its shortage. In this regard, the tasks of the spectrum management become more complex every year, acquire a systematic character and cover all areas of radio communication and other types of information transmission using radio waves. The article presents the results of the analysis of the methods used to control the use of the radio frequency spectrum. The possibilities and prospects of using innovative methods of spectrum management are revealed. Special attention is paid to combining the use of technical and market methods

articleTitle: Human Resource Capacity of Quality Management Based on Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of the digital economy and digital technologies of quality management requires improving the training of quality specialists. The traditional path of a small change in the curriculum no longer provides the necessary level of qualification of graduates. There was a need to develop new training courses and specializations at the bachelor's and master's level. As an example, we can cite the new course “Quality Management based on digital technologies”, implemented at the Department “Quality Management” in MAI. Especially relevant is the introduction of digital technologies in the new curricula that are being prepared as part of the reorganization of the nomenclature of specialties and areas of training. This also applies to postgraduate studies, where the new nomenclature has already been approved and will be introduced next year. Within the framework of the new specialty 5.2.22, which includes the existing 05.02.22 (Production Organization) and 05.02.23 (Quality Management), digital technologies are included in the specialty passport.

articleTitle: On-line and Off-line Educational Means of the Industrial Region Engineers and Academic Staff Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Regional well-being depends on the quality of engineering qualifications. Universities deal with a twofold task: training students to work in high-tech industries and the employee qualifications continuous development at industrial enterprises. Rapid technological changes lead to a negative synergetic effect and a problem of high-quality education: lack of teaching expertise leads to insufficient employee readiness to work in new conditions. To solve this problem, we suggest introducing a combination of online and offline means to train engineers and academic staff of technical departments. These means include: online monitoring of job functions update along with offline discussions with company management; project and innovation activities training; providing online information concerning advanced programs of additional professional education; creating electronic analogs storing educational content of distance learning programs; organizing education using project-based learning technologies and mutual learning.

articleTitle: Developing Architecture of Electronic Means of Ensuring the Safe Crossing of Railway Tracks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the development of a technical solution for a complex signaling and blocking system that increases the safety of crossing railway tracks that are not provided with crossing at different levels. A probabilistic model of the object states, taking into account the analysis of the vehicles movement and the pedestrians flow, is considered to form the indicators of the railway crossing functioning. The probability of a safe crossing over tracks free of rolling stock is determined based on the dynamic model of railway crossing states in the form of a lognormal distribution. An example of a technical solution for the equipment of a railway crossing point that provides increased safety is considered using the obtained stochastic model. The scheme of the complex system of the crossing arrangement including means of monitoring of the rolling stock approach speed, sensors of determining the pedestrians' position, automated means of the alarm and blocking is developed. The effectiveness of the proposed methodology for ensuring the safe crossing of railway tracks is justified.

articleTitle: Features of Evaluating and Managing the Resources of Mobile Virtual Network Operators of Digital Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the features of the activities of mobile virtual network operators that are part of the digital ecosystems of Russian banks (VTB Mobile, Tinkoff mobile, Sberbank Mobile). The sharing of communication networks by multiple operators reduces the cost of network deployment. At the present stage of the formation and development of platform business models in the field of cellular communications, virtual operators, using in their technological solutions the main assets of the base operators, face the management problem of the current and future assessment of the state and use of financial resources. Changes in the nature of the structural and cost impact on the values of indicators reflecting the level of state and use of fixed and working capital of MVNO should be taken into account in predictive modeling.

articleTitle: The International Cargo Transportations in South Russian Transport and Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Digitalization is becoming a key area for improving the efficiency of the transport industry. Planning of effective measures for the operational management of transportation is based on the information integration of transport market operators, enterprises of various modes of transport and other transport participants. In the article, the authors examine the structure of integrated electronic documents in multimodal international transport. The authors consider the smart platform “TradeLens”, based on blockchain technology. The electronic transport passport is a key element of the platform. Using the example of the southern regional transport logistics system, the authors suggest the need to switch to blockchain technologies and introduce an electronic transport passport. This will ensure the sustainable development of the international transport system.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly penetrating the everyday life of people. Sometimes we do not even think that certain technologies that make our life easier and more comfortable work in conjunction with artificial intelligence methods. However, the rapid growth in penetration of such technologies carries a number of risks. These risks are related to the security of personal data. This paper examines trends in the use of artificial intelligence in everyday life of people. The authors made an attempt to make a connection between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence. Also, the issues of cyberattacks using artificial intelligence and attacks on artificial intelligence are considered.

articleTitle: System Optimization of Technological Design by Switching to Additive Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Any production activity of the modern world is directly determined by the processing of information, the application of information technologies and innovative solutions to existing tasks. In matters related to the development of technological processes, there are quite a few questions. When developing algorithms for processing a material or creating a product, you need to start from the material itself, as well as modern devices that allow you to use them most productively. To date, such technological processes as casting, stamping, welding in mechanical engineering, as well as soldering or surface mounting of electronic components are well established. A fairly large number of standard solutions are known and the processing mechanisms are clear, however, the development of progress forces us to move further and requires a revision of such methods, in particular, determines the feasibility of switching to additive technologies.

articleTitle: Smart Tool for Tracing Humidity and Temperature of Products During Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the ability to trace products with humidity and temperature requirements to the end user. Sometimes the supply chain includes up to 7 sub-distributors, it is very important to track temperature and humidity from manufacturer to end client. In accordance with ISO 13485, traceability should be included to QMS. This application track geolocation and add sub distributors in process of transportation. Loggers including WIFI for transfer data in timely manner. Moreover, it is fully integrated with the system for dealing with nonconformance, which allows to automate the process of opening nonconformance and reduce the costs of damage products. If during transportation humidity or temperature range will be higher or lower that required, system automatically open nonconformance and assign to correct person. Smart Tool for tracing transportation of humidity and temperature control product can improve QMS logistic process.

articleTitle: Application of Information and Communication Technologies in Hybrid Learning of Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the application of a hybrid learning strategy in higher education as a didactic tool for transition from the traditional educational model to an integrated one. The authors analyse possibilities to implement the model in teaching a foreign language to engineering students following the results of the survey conducted among them. The didactic principles of organising the the educational process based on hybrid learning are formulated in the article. The results of the experimental research on implementing the hybrid learning strategy are provided.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Transportation System in Multimodal Freight Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of the international transport system. Digitalization of the transport industry involves an automated process of managing cargo flows. In this regard, the authors propose the structure of the intelligent transport system of international transport from the point of view of ensuring the sustainable development of international multimodal transportation and improving the efficiency, safety and ecological compatibility of transport. This intelligent transport system allows us to automate the process of finding and making safe decisions to develop effective scenarios for managing the transport and logistics complex.

articleTitle: Modeling Publication Terminology Maps on Quality Assessment Problems of Printed Circuit Boards
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: For the first time, the analysis of terminological maps of publications on the problems of assessing the quality of manufacturing and tracing of printed circuit boards is considered. Scopus and Web of Science were chosen as databases storing articles for analysis. The standard tools of the Scopus and WoS site, as well as the software for constructing distribution maps VOSviewer, were selected as the analysis tool. Relationships between articles have been built, terminological maps have been created, which make it possible to visually assess the scale and time of publications.

articleTitle: Gamification Components of a Software Solution Using a Neural Network in the Design of Unified Information and Analytical Space of a University
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article examines the gamification components of a software solution developed using a neural network, which makes it possible to increase the efficiency of the educational process, improve the programming skills and operational thinking of future IT specialists in the applied informatics field of training. For clarity, the described gamification components are used in the developed software solution to improve the educational process. The article also presents a model of intellectual creativity of future IT specialists in the Applied Informatics field of training, which contributes to a comfortable and effective educational process. This model is being tested on the GPA YALTA portal.

articleTitle: Hybrid Project-Based Learning in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Technological advancement, global fostering innovative activities, digitization resulted in sustained demand for highly qualified engineers. Current engineering education and real-world requirements have drifted apart. The authors offer a hybrid framework with integrated edtech tools of online project-based learning. Russian and Tajikistan Universities were involved in the tandem project. The research provides the analysis of feedback of 35 tandem students majoring in engineering in 2020-2021 academic year. The research based on needs analysis, a questionnaire, and semi-structural interviews proved the efficiency of hybrid format for ESP training, revealed the importance of online course implementation – the students improved their communication and ESP skills. Diverse methodological, linguistic, and even psychological difficulties, faced by the students studied online were examined. The findings of this study promoted the development of a modern project-based online course for future engineers.

articleTitle: Information and Functional Security of Distributed Information Processing Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Issues of organization of information security in modern distributed systems, including the Internet of things, are considered. The possibilities of integrating the means and methods of functional and information security are discussed. Mathematical models for calculating the parameters of systems are given, taking into account the requirements of the integrity and availability of information. Possible solutions for a distributed document control system are shown.

articleTitle: Evidence-Based Modeling of Thermal Processes in Printed Circuit Assemblies of Optoelectronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of “evidence-based modeling” is introduced. The authors understand it as a scientific approach to the practice of optoelectronic devices (OED) designing, in which design decisions are made based on the results of computer modeling of physical processes using well-known, repeatedly used programs with experimentally confirmed modeling errors. The authors show that the effectiveness of computer modeling is to reduce the time and cost of the overall development cycle of the OED with the given output technical characteristics, while ensuring high accuracy and reliability. These characteristics of the OED quality must contain reasonable reserves for electrical, thermal, mechanical and other physical loads on electrical radio elements and on supporting structures. The most important characteristics are the load factors in terms of electrical power and temperatures of the electrical radio elements cases for high-precision OEDs built into ground and on-board radio-electronic equipment. In this paper, we will consider the evidence of computer thermal modeling using well-known programs. This is demonstrated by examples of ASONIKA-T and ASONIKA-TM programs.

articleTitle: Review of Modern Vulnerabilities in Blockchain Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Blockchain technology has recently entered the life of a modern person. This technology is quite young. It is developing very rapidly. More and more industries are adopting this technology. However, technical regulation procedures lag behind the development of the technology itself. There are a number of issues related to the security of personal data. This article examines the current vulnerabilities of modern blockchain systems. An attempt was made to systematize vulnerabilities depending on their nature of occurrence. The reasons for the emergence of such vulnerabilities are identified, primarily related to the lack of international standards for the development of such systems.

articleTitle: Integral Method for Evaluating the Effectiveness of Electronic Interaction between the State and the Population and Business in the Context of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article substantiates a holistic method of expert evaluation of the effectiveness of electronic interaction between the state, the population and business to measure the positive and negative manifestations of socio-economic effects in the implementation of e-government projects at various levels of government. The task is to develop a model of the integrated effectiveness of electronic control system projects for various multidirectional manifestations of economic and social effects (positive, negative). The methodology of the formation of private indicators of an effective and costly nature, the order of expert evaluation and the algorithm for solving the problem are considered on the example of the implementation of the federal project “Digital Public Administration” at the beginning and at the end of the project. The mechanism of applying the results of a comprehensive efficiency assessment and identified reserves / bottlenecks in the e-government systems disclosed.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Early Prediction of Alzheimer's Diseases
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: It has now been confirmed that the main cause of dementia is Alzheimer's disease. It is characterized as neurodegenerative, chronic, progressive, and belonging to the category of incurable. The clinical picture of the disease's manifestation includes cognitive dysfunction, amnesia, gradual loss of multiple brain functions and the lack independence in daily functioning. To reduce the risk of its occurrence, it is necessary to identify the MCI in advance. In our work, we aim to describe a method that helps to detect signs of early onset of AD with the help of CNN. Sagittal, axial, and coronary MRI slices were used to train CNN models for a number of classification tasks; then these CNN models were combined into one group. The paper also discusses image and dataset preprocessing. The method can find its application in medicine for the delivery of a diagnosis at stages when the changes in the brain are so small that a medical expert cannot yet detect them.

articleTitle: Using Computer Algebra System Maple for Teaching the Basics of the Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the module ‘Finite element method in solving problems of Structural Mechanics’ of ‘Mathematical Modeling’ course for students pursuing a bachelor's degree in Construction field of study. The content includes the Finite Element Method (FEM) as a general method for the numerical solution of differential equations, as well as problem analysis with Computer Algebra System (CAS) Maple. It took seven years to carry out the educational experiment. 73 students from Sholom-Aleichem Priamursky State University, Pacific National University, Naryn State University, Far Eastern State Transport University, and Moscow State University of Civil Engineering participated in it. Most graduates who undertook further study in a master's program showed a higher level of mathematical proficiency and the skill of using top-of-the-line software systems designed to perform structural calculations. Therefore, the CAS Maple used in the course of FEM will give new insight into the principles and algorithms of this method. This will allow future builders to investigate component parts of any complexity in different current software suites.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Networks in Production Control Tasks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The solution of problems of management of discrete multi-nomenclature production is in many respects like the problems of optimization of systems defined by many parameters. Many different theories are devoted to these problems. Such problems are solved by mathematical methods of operations research, numerical minimization methods and many others. In our case, however, each new production management problem associated with the production of a product is not a separate problem but has some continuities. Each new production management system carries with it some aspects of previously used methods. In this regard, it is proposed to apply the apparatus of artificial intelligence to solve the problems of production management. Each new task of optimal choice of parameters for production management must be based on previously obtained solutions. It is proposed to create a teachable system, which gives a solution based on the accumulated “knowledge”. The proposed approach should increase the enterprise's mobility in making management decisions at all levels of management, throughout the entire life cycle. The models under development will be a functional extension of digital production processes.

articleTitle: Formalized Models of the Space of Properties in the Problem of Complex Assessment of the State of Management Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The stage of description of the management situation in the situational approach to management decisions is investigated. The U class of control situations is considered as an object class, describing the same set of properties W, and is constructed as a name in a set of classes of a certain form. Based on the analysis of the basic system principles of generating a description of the control situation, topological characteristics of the “property space” are formulated, which is the basis for building an evaluation system and an evaluation base at. A comparison of topological characteristics of “property space” with basic system principles of control situation generation is given. A generalized mathematical setting of the problem of estimating the control situation in the “situation-action” models is formulated, defining it as the problem of constructing algebraic structure on the class is of the following objects with a relation of order and its monotonic mapping to the space of measures for estimating the state of the control object.

articleTitle: Method of Computer Simulation of Thermal Processes in Optoelectronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Taking into account the functional and design features of optoelectronic devices, this paper proposes to divide the process of developing their thermal macromodels into several stages related to the idealization of the design and the purpose of isothermal volumes. The authors also considered the principle of transition to topological thermal models of structural elements of an optoelectronic device. The paper studies the features of replacing the calculations of heat transfer processes in an optoelectronic device with calculations of electrical processes in the corresponding circuits based on the electrothermal analogy. The material of this work is presented as a method of hierarchical computer modeling of thermal processes in optoelectronic devices

articleTitle: Methods for Formation of Recommendations for the Modernization of Production Process Based on Automated Analysis of its Digital Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Digitalization of production and the transition to intelligent technologies for managing production processes are becoming key competitive advantages of modern enterprises. It is possible to understand how efficiently the enterprise as a whole functions and how rationally all its processes are organized by analyzing the digital model of the production process. Such model can be obtained fully or partly automatically depending on the current digitalization level. Analysis of the model can reveal “bottlenecks” of processes, insufficient integration of applied automated systems, inefficiency in the use of equipment and human resources etc. Based on the results of the analysis, as well as information about the constraints (time, financial, etc.) and the goals of the enterprise, recommendations for carrying out the modernization of production in the given conditions should be developed. This paper is devoted to the description of the approach to formalizing the rules for the formation of such recommendations.

articleTitle: Assessment of Information Security in Integrated Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the typesetting and structural model of an information protection system. An algorithm for analyzing information security based on a structural model of an information security system is also presented. The goal of the work is to develop an information security analysis algorithm based on a structural model of an information security system. Methods. In order to achieve the goal, a typesetting model of an information protection system and a structural model of an information protection system were considered. The result of this work is the presentation of a fragment of the algorithm. Findings. The computer model presented in the article makes it possible to determine the value of an information system security assessment, it provides the results of security analysis in quantitative form.

Author Keywords: assessment of the security of the information security system

articleTitle: Criteria and Levels of Formation of Intellectual Creativity of Future IT Specialists
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the criteria and levels of formation of intellectual creativity of students in the “Applied Informatics” field of training. The significance of the study lies in the verification of the thesis that it is advisable to provide scientific and methodological support for the implementation of pedagogical conditions for the effective development of intellectual creativity of future IT specialists. The proposed conditions are focused on ensuring the purposeful mastery of systemic knowledge, skills, and competence for working with various IT technologies in the process of learning programming languages.

Author Keywords: criteria for the formation of intellectual creativity
levels of formation of intellectual creativity

articleTitle: Method of Designing an Intelligent System for Making Design and Technological Decisions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The design of production processes is based on the adoption of design and technological decisions by specialists. Conventionally, these decisions can be divided into two categories: rational - these are decisions that are based on well-formalized knowledge, and irrational - these are decisions that are based on the experience of a specialist, his intuition, emotions, inner conviction, i.e. on his expertise. The greatest difficulty is the automation of the irrational function of a specialist. A general method of creating such automated systems is considered. It is noted that in order to create an intelligent system, one of the steps should be the decomposition of the cognitive function of a specialist into the levels of modes. Further, it is proposed to each mode to associate some intelligent basic procedure. In the future, integrate intelligent basic procedures for the required configuration of an intelligent system. The proposed method does not pretend to be complete, but it allows you to streamline knowledge about some of the principles underlying decision-making by specialists, and about the directions of compensation for their intellectual functions in the process of making design and technological decisions.

articleTitle: Customer Loyalty Management in the Context of Digital Transformation of Business
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In conditions of business digital transformation, possibilities of equal comparison between manufacturers and quick customer switching in the digital environment, the formation of customer loyalty has become more complicated. In the meantime, new information and communication channels (social networks and platforms) and new ways of building relationships with the consumer (personalization, co-creation, consumerism, crowdsourcing, crowdfunding) are developing. Under the conditions of multiplatform communications in the digital environment it is necessary to manage the integrated structure of digital marketing communications on a trustworthy basis. The integrated structure of digital marketing communications is considered as an interacting set of touch points between the organization and its consumers, which follows the principles of integrity, elements compatibility, polyfunctionality, development, lability, and variability. The subject of digital transformation has moved beyond the automation and now deals with the issues of changing the managers' mentality towards the creation of breakthrough business models and new formats of loyalty building.

articleTitle: Benefits of Organizing Remote Education in the Design of a University's Unified Information and Analytical Space Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study aims to substantiate the importance of using a UIAS of the university for organizing remote education. The creation of a UIAS allows organizing accounting, storage and accessing the data collected in the course of the work of the structural divisions of the university online. It helps consolidating the date which is relevant and important for generating reports and analytical documentation of divisions when organizing remote education.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Sets in the Problems of Assessing the Quality of Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the issues of building a base of fuzzy inference rules for solving problems of assessing the quality of mobile applications. The solution to this problem is based on the use of the main provisions of the PNST277-2018 standard “Comparative tests of mobile applications for smartphones”. It is shown that the hierarchical organization of software quality models is a prerequisite for creating a base of rules for fuzzy inference. A general algebraic algorithm for constructing the structure of a mobile application quality model is presented. An example of describing fuzzy rules for the implementation of the problem of assessing the characteristics of the maintainability of a mobile application is given. It is proposed to use the Fussy Logic Toolbox MatLab package as a tool for creating a fuzzy expert system to support the process of comparative research of the quality of mobile applications.

articleTitle: Integration of Knowledge Management Systems and Product Data in a Single Information Space of a High-Tech Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers one of the promising directions of information technology development in modern industry — the introduction and ensuring the effective functioning of product data management systems. The advantages are shown and the main groups of the problem of implementing and ensuring the effective functioning of product data management systems at high-tech enterprises are identified. The prevailing role of the group of organizational and managerial problems is determined as one of the most significant in the context of the negative impact on the effectiveness of the implementation and functioning of product data management systems. A methodology for integrating knowledge management systems and product data is developed as the main set of measures to solve a group of organizational and managerial problems. The developed methodology was tested on the example of a really functioning high-tech instrument-making enterprise.

articleTitle: Prototyping Electronic Devices on a Dragonfly 3D Printer as a Means of Preserving Original Developments inside the Design Center
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the currently developing technology of printed electronics. Using the example of the operation of the first in Russia 3D printer DragonFly 2020 LDM, one of the advantages of using printed additive manufacturing inside design centers for the design of electronic devices is shown, as a means of preserving original developments when creating prototypes. The main design and technological characteristics of printed electronics are presented.

articleTitle: Automation of Loading and Unloading Operations Based on an Electric Drive with Dynamic Braking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed article provides a comparative analysis of the existing electric drives of the gantry crane lifting mechanism and justifies the choice of an electric drive with dynamic braking as the main factor affecting the efficiency of organizing the work of unloading areas with the use of overhead vibro dischargers.

articleTitle: Software for the Agent-based Simulation System of the Enterprises with Banks Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the software development for the agent-based simulation system of the interaction of small business enterprises with the banking sector. The main stages of software development are considered. At the first stage, an agent-based model of the functioning of small businesses was developed, and the decomposition of enterprises into classes according to the Durand method was proposed. At the second stage, an agent-based model of the banking sector was developed, as well as an algorithm for interaction between enterprises and banks. At the third stage, experimental studies were conducted and the performance indicators of enterprises were computed using the developed software of the agent-based simulation system.

articleTitle: Integration of CAD and ERP Technologies in the Project Activities of Students of Engineering, Information and Economic Specialties
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: For the implementation of project activities, information technologies are used that provide modeling of technical and economic systems, including augmented reality technologies and virtual reality technologies. Modeling allows you to identify the “bottlenecks” of the projected object, to evaluate the technical characteristics of the object. An important problem in modeling is the integration of CAD and ERP technologies, taking into account the features of industrial production. The implementation of joint project activities of students of engineering, information and economic specialties will provide an integrated approach to the technical, engineering and organizational and economic aspects of modeling and designing objects and the development of digital production tools.

articleTitle: The Safety of Technological Solutions in the Digital Transformation of the Transportation Complex
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Ensuring the quality control of service and the safety of technological solutions are very relevant issues in the context of the transportation complex digital transformation. The term “technological safety” includes, along with transport and information aspects, also technogenic one: production processes carried out with the use of new technologies should be aimed at reducing technogenic risks. The article is devoted to the development of methods for minimizing various groups of technological solutions risks for digital transformation. On the basis of the proposed morphological model, the authors developed a criterion of a safe technological solution in the digital transformation of the transportation complex. The algorithm of the solutions step-by-step verification for compliance with technological risk profiles, presented in the article, allows, depending on the identified risk profiles, to form actions to minimize them, as well as to implement the actions in the production activities of transport organizations.

articleTitle: Data Processing and Computing the Integral Indexes of Russian Regions Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the data processing on the state of the real sector in the regions of the Russian Federation based on the application of intelligent methods: principal components, cluster analysis, Kohonen neural network, neuro-fuzzy network. The research concept is developed, which involves the chain of processes: decomposition of the initial characteristics set of the real sector in regions; composition of the detailed characteristics of regions clusters; computing the integral indexes of the regions development. The results of the research made it possible to develop trajectories of movement of regions from less developed clusters to more developed ones and formulate rules for decision support on adjusting regional expenditures.

articleTitle: Review of Systems for Issuing and Verifying Library Cards Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: For libraries, the main task is to serve readers quickly, to manage library collections efficiently, and to control the circulation of books in the library. Blockchain technology, due to its decentralization and impossibility to “swap” data, namely the implementation of the library card on the blockchain, is a great solution to improve the quality of libraries. This paper reviewed the existing solutions for the implementation of the library ticket based on blockchain technology, their analogues, described the principle of their work and features. The prospects for the development of this direction are considered.

articleTitle: Use of Absolute Randomness System to Ensure Information Security
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper outlines a new information protection technology based on absolute randomness when sending data packets. This technology can solve many important information security problems. The solution below is reviewed for the specific industry, although it can be modified for any needs. At the end of the article there is provided a brief description of the programming solution developed for this technology implementation.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Dangerous Events Occurrence in Technological Processes in Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with general approaches to constructing models of stochastic processes in complex technological systems from the standpoint of the reliability theory. A model of the dangerous eventsoccurrence in production activities is considered on the example of the railway transport infrastructure functioningprobabilistic approaches. The parameters of the hazard flows impact on the environment and humans are considered. The method of safety management within the “man - machine - production environment” system is proposed. The automatic warning signaling systems that ensure the safety of people working on railway tracks are considered as an example of the practical use of the simulation results. The advantages and disadvantages of individual hardware implementations of automatic alarm systems with different operating principles are analyzed. Recommendations for the analysis and prediction of the dangerous eventsoccurrence and ensuring occupational safety in technological processes in railway transport are developed.

articleTitle: Ensuring Reliability and Safety of the Continuous Passenger Transport Technical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of ensuring the reliability and operational safety of continuous passenger transport vehicles for the nodal objects of the urban transport network. The analysis and risk assessment of the reliability of continuous passenger transport technical systems are carried out using expert methods, tools of the theory of reliability and risk management. The reliability and safety of escalators are analyzed on the example of transfer stations of the Moscow metro. A design method for improving safety is proposed based on the analysis of the key causes of the most common dangerous failures. The entrance and intermediate tests project for the rolling supports for escalator stair treads is considered as an example of the corrective actions to improve reliability. Methodological recommendations for ensuring the reliability and safety of the functioning of the continuous passenger transport technical systems at the transport infrastructure objects of the metropolis are proposed.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Digital Environment to Strengthen Systematization of Engineers' Competencies Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The information and communication digital environment is widely introduced in education today, and it often covers the educational discipline content considering its presentation possibilities. The use of the environment as structured content storage does not fully contribute to engineers' competencies development. We believe the environment can offer such competitive advantages as the following qualities: adaptive, interdisciplinary, informative, and communicative. These qualities help develop a system of universal and professional engineers' competencies. The adaptive environment enables personalized learning. The interdisciplinarity promotes competencies mastering using synthesized material of humanitarian and technical disciplines. Finally, the information and communication environment allows collected data processing and captures personalized interdisciplinary interaction between teachers and students. This paper presents the structure of adaptive interdisciplinary information and communication digital environment. The pedagogical experiment proved its effectiveness in engineers' systematic competencies development.

articleTitle: The Unique Challenges of Teaching Artificial Intelligence Systems to Mechatronics and Robotics Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The process of teaching students is associated with the teaching of a number of disciplines. Such a wide range of skills and abilities that a student must master leads to some difficulties for students taking disciplines in which artificial intelligence systems are taught. Therefore, the question of a more effective methodically constructed formation of the learning process is relevant. This article describes the experience of teaching the subject of pattern recognition using neural networks to students in the direction of mechatronics and robotics.

articleTitle: Project Management in the Website UX / UI Development: System-Oriented Analysis and Business Process Management Principles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The website interface quality depends on a project management method, since the duration of managerial delays, improper management of large volumes of metrics, excessively increased testing time and other human factors are caused by project management errors. The correct project management methodology can bring economic and social benefits to the users and IT companies. The article describes the BPMS-based project management method and its impact on the interface quality.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for the Russian Language Speech Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this article, we suggest a method for creating a high-quality model of speech synthesis for the Russian language. Even though the task of speech synthesis is widespread, only large corporations can create high-quality models of speech synthesis since this requires a large amount of well-processed data recorded by the voice of one person. The proposed method allows the creation of a speech synthesis model, using about 30 minutes of target speech and about 20 hours of speech from different people from open sources. This model will be comparable in quality to the models of large companies that were trained on large amounts of data.

articleTitle: Risk Simulation Based on Variational Bayesian Neural Network in Integrated Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes a method characterized by consumers engagement as “risk experts”. The method is used to build a Bayesian network and to predict the Net Promoter Score (NPS); it provides practical tools for business process analysis by applying advanced technologies to visualization of performance data using a dashboard in Power BI. Business processes in integrated management systems are unstable (as opposed to process operations) and depend on many factors, and therefore require the use of Bayesian networks. When testing the suggested method in an aviation company and taking into account the development of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence technologies, the authors programmed a machine-learning algorithm for Bayesian networks. The article provides examples of statistical analysis under real-life conditions and risk assessment of customer satisfaction using a Bayesian network and neural networks that underline the practical aspect of the developed method.

articleTitle: Prospects for the Use of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study devoted to the analysis of the proliferation activity of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in higher education and the reasons that interfere with this process. The results of a questionnaire survey of employees and leaders of educational organizations in relation to the prospects for the use of artificial intelligence. It has been proven that technical universities and universities - “leaders” are more active and more successful in introducing AI into the educational process. The proliferation of AI in the education organizations is most influenced by the presence of a critical mass of employees with the appropriate competencies. There is a dissimilarity in forecasts about the prospects for the introduction of AI in the groups of universities leading and not so successful. Introductio

Author Keywords: prospects for using AI in higher education

articleTitle: Terminological Maps of Publications on the Transformation of Students' Professional Orientations in the Context of their Internet Socialization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of identifying the components of the transformation of professional orientations of students at the interdisciplinary level is urgent. It is connected with their Internet socialization. For the first time terminology maps on the problem of research have been considered. Raw data were downloaded from Scopus and Web of Science. The selected tool is the program VOSviewer. New terms, relationships between articles were identified and terminology maps were created. The results are applicable to the researchers of the problem.

articleTitle: To the Question of Transport Infrastructure Development in Conditions of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Since implementation of digital projects for transport infrastructure development has fragmental nature, some modern trends and promising directions for implementation of digital projects and introduction of modern high-performance information technology are defined in the paper. These trends and directions are determined on the basis of a thorough analysis of the concept of transport infrastructure from the point of view of modern legislation of the Russian Federation, management methodology in socioeconomic, logistics and engineering systems. The authors of the paper have considered some examples of successful digitalization projects in the field of road construction automation, intellectualization of the road economy when it comes to data exchange and traffic management. As a result, key priority of the digital projects implementation in transport industry is substantiated.

articleTitle: Ensuring Safety at Transport Infrastructure Facilities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of safety management in railway transport in the rolling stock movement area. A model of pedestrian traffic in the flow at the intersection of railway tracks is constructed based on probabilistic approaches. The spatio-temporal characteristics of the obtained probability distributions are analyzed for different traffic conditions at different pedestrian traffic intensities, taking into account the age groups. Recommendations for the development and application of statistical-probabilistic methods for ensuring safety in railway transport are developed.

articleTitle: Dynamic Processes in Electrical Circuits with Nonlinear Passive Elements
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A lot of electrotechnical systems are nonlinear, that is why the study of dynamic processes in nonlinear electrical circuits is very important and advisable. Dynamic analysis is performed in electrical circuits with nonlinear passive elements. Such elements include nonlinear resistors, which are described by the piecewise-linear volt-ampere characteristics, inductances and capacities. The analytic analysis of some nonlinear circuits, as well as the results of their numerical analysis in the MATLAB system are represented. The importance of the numerical analysis study is emphasized, since the complexity of electrotechnical systems makes it difficult to build their analytical models in practice.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Based on Evidence in the Quality Management of Innovation Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of new materials for electrical installation work, new magnetic materials for electronics with special properties is possible using rapid solidification technology. This technology should be supported by a quality management methodology. The article describes a model for implementing the principle of quality management - making decisions based on actual data. It includes procedures for collecting, processing, analyzing, and interpreting data. For its application, the method of decomposition and evaluation of the key parameter of the quality of the technological process is used. The technology audit method is then applied to evaluate the production environment based on the new criteria. To adjust the control, the method of iterative improvement of the quality of the process is used. To improve the process, the method of complex application of statistical methods is used. The developed model makes it possible to increase the efficiency of the integrated management system of enterprises producing electrical materials.

articleTitle: Application of Expert Systems in Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the possibility of building and implementing expert systems in quality management systems. The development of new information technologies leads to the emergence of new ways of solving various problems, both familiar and specific. Expert systems using artificial intelligence, one way or another, have already found their application in various spheres of human existence, which leads to an increase in their use. This also applies to quality management systems, which are constantly striving to improve the business and meet the needs of the consumer. The use of expert systems can facilitate the work of quality specialists, relieving them of part of the routine burden of solving simple problems. Also, expert systems are capable of processing more data than a specialist expert. The article reflects what tasks the expert system can solve, what it needs to “learn” from a specialist expert (find out how an expert evaluates certain situations), the principle of operation of such systems will also be reflected: what elements should be in the system and how they should be correct to tie.

articleTitle: Management Models Based on the Situational Approach in the Presence of Factors of Fuzziness and Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of mathematical support of the situational approach to the development of systems to support management decision-making in the management and forecasting of the development of complex objects. The sequence of the main stages of making a management decision in the situational approach is given, based on the analysis of which the features of the formal description of management objects of various nature are highlighted. A special feature of the approach proposed in the article is the combination of a situational approach to decision-making, heuristic methods and algorithms based on the use of fuzzy set theory.

articleTitle: Analysis of Risks in Security Threats to the Object of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is concerned with the analysis of the emergence of possible security threats to the object of informatization. The main types of threats and approaches to their definition are presented and described. Recommendations are given for determining their application regarding the object of informatization.

Author Keywords: threats to the object of informatization

articleTitle: Modal Methods for Biological and Biotechnical Systems' Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper shows an approach to multivariate analysis of a complex hydrodynamic system using the example of the human cardiovascular system. Simultaneously recorded biomedical signals of various physical nature (electrocardiogram, seismocardiogram, photoplethysmogram, laser flowgram) being used. Methods for obtaining the parameters of such a system are presented, a technique for transition to a multidimensional space of mode expansions is described, and a method for modal analysis of several signals is shown. The differences in the portraits of the states of the system and transitions between them, depending on the functional state of the organism, are illustrated.

articleTitle: Digital Communication Channels of Government Departments
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents results of the study of communication channels of public authorities to assess them and identify prospects for their digital transformation. A comparative analysis of communication channels showed that the most voluminous in terms of the number of messages are social media, but this channel is inferior to social media in terms of the number of views and calls to messages posted in social networks. Digital transformation of communication channels consists in the collection and processing of digital data, which will be most productive in web environment.
