Currently Russian government departments take advantages from popular social media just partly, so the web communication channels are still having great prospects for development of interaction with citizens.

articleTitle: Architecture Model of Digital Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the prospects for digital transformation of the quality management system (QMS), as well as the problems that companies and organizations may meet while implementing the process of digital transformation. It is substantiated that without defining and considering the architecture of the quality management system, its digitalization will not be efficient enough. With a view to ensure and improve the efficiency of the QMS in the process of its digitalization, the concept of “architecture of quality management system” is disclosed. The architecture model proposed by the authors will improve the efficiency of management both by implementing digital quality management tools and by the QMS components themselves.

articleTitle: Review of Modern Blockchain Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Developers who are seriously thinking about developing products that use blockchain need to be serious about choosing a blockchain platform. Blockchain allows you to create a link between manufacturing, logistics and finance. This means that the choice of a blockchain platform must meet a number of criteria, one of which is security. The paper discusses online and local blockchain platforms, as well as the types of blockchain and consensus algorithms that are used in modern blockchain platforms. The paper compares modern blockchain platforms in terms of security, usability and ease of use.

articleTitle: The Main Directions of Ensuring Cybersecurity in Russia and the World
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the modern world, issues related to cybersecurity are increasingly posed. Cybersecurity is a narrower area than information security protection. It is necessary to develop such measures to ensure cybersecurity that will ensure its cross-border properties. Each country has its own cybersecurity legislation. Each measure has its own pros and cons. In order to ensure the universality of methods for investigating cybercrimes, which would allow them to be investigated regardless of the country of commission. This paper discusses the main cybersecurity threats in 2021 and the main directions of cybersecurity in the world.

articleTitle: Business Process Management System Modernization Using Neural Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the principles of operation of modern BPM systems, their functions and disadvantages. Solutions to the operation problems are described. The concept of a BPM-system modernized with the help of neural technologies is developed. Using the Business Site company as an example, QMS effectiveness criteria are identified and ways to improve the QMS effectiveness are proposed. The process of training IT employees using this system is described. The modernization of BPM systems that manage business processes can initiate the automation of enterprises with the help of neural technologies. In general, almost all innovations in neural technologies are aimed to expand the scope of their application.

Author Keywords: IECQ - IEC system for assessing the quality of electronic components

articleTitle: Digital Communications Management of the Organization in the Conditions of the Media Prosumerism Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In conditions of digital transformation, the communication interaction between the organization and the consumer has been changed. In terms of digital environment, the consumer is considered as a specialist who is competent in media at the interpersonal and mass levels as a media producer. Media prosumerism has a dual nature: on the one hand, it complicates the process of controlling the product's communicational support; on the other hand, it provides opportunities to increase audience engagement. Digitalization encourages companies to rebuild product value chains, relying on the co-creativity and initiative of prosumers. The purpose of the research is to describe the management instruments of digital communications under the conditions of media space convergence. This research explores the tools of interaction with the media prosumers, such as influence marketing, rephrase marketing, SMM, new media, and educational marketing. The results from the interaction between the organization and media prosumers are also described.

articleTitle: The State of an Electrical Contact Connection as a Diagnostic Object
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The parameters characterizing the state and quality of an electrical contact connection, considered as an element of common system - an electrical circuit, including an electrical contact connection in its composition, are considered. It is shown that in this case, the complete set of parameters characterizing the state and quality of the electrical contact connection should also include indicators of the vibroactivity of the electrical contact connection.

articleTitle: The Modern Information System of Sleep Structure Detection in Polysomnographic Data Systems Approaches
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study presented in the article is aimed at developing automatic methods to identify different stages of night sleep in humans. Proposed information system is based on using of time-frequency analysis of polysomnographic data in post-processing mode. The preliminary analysis of data set presents a sufficiently high degree of accuracy and reliability when compared with the results of the evaluation of the professional medical somnologist. This approach to the analysis of polysomnographic signals can be considered as an additional study, for example, with apnoe control, and serve as an independent objective marker for assessing the risks of sleep structure's impairments.

articleTitle: Application of Building Information Modeling Technologies at the Design Stages of Real Estate Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses and analyzes the main processes of designing real estate objects. Based on the analysis of the design processes, the cataloging of IT services applicable at the design stages is carried out. Methods for improving and reengineering business processes in the concept of informatization and automation of design processes are presented. The characteristics of the main existing information technologies of design and modeling and the criteria for their selection are given. The choice of BIM technologies in the design of estate objects is justified. The binding of IT processes of BIM technologies to the processes of estate objects design is given. The advantages of using the technology in project activities are identified: improving the efficiency of process management, preventing errors in the design of estate objects and the operation of construction objects, which can significantly improve the efficiency of decision-making at all stages of the creation of IT. The directions of further development of the software and the prospects of its use in the construction industry are considered.

articleTitle: Model of Growth of the Plant on the Example of the Snowdrop Caucasian (Galanthus Caucasicus)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The subject of the study is the Caucasian snowdrop (Galanthus Caucasicus (Baker) Grossh) and this is due to the fact that this plant is listed in the Red Book and is protected by the state. Also, the genus Galnthus is one of the most interesting in terms of the study of its ecological and biological features. The constructed regression equations for each simulated component are given, which were used as the basis for a simulation model of plant growth and development (Caucasian snowdrop). This model reflects the values of the physical size of a plant at various stages of its development. An algorithm was developed that was implemented in Visual Basic 6.0; The program allows you to calculate the numerical values of the components of the flower depending on the time, which are presented in the form of tables and graphs of the functions obtained, as well as a schematic representation of the plant at different stages of its development.

Author Keywords: model of growth and development of plants

articleTitle: The Use of Information Technology in the Strategic Management and Planning of a Digital Technology Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This scientific work is devoted to the study of two main areas: the study of the practice and effectiveness of information systems strategic planning as a function of strategic management in digital technology enterprises. The relevance of research results aims to ensure consistency between information technology and the business strategy of a digital technology enterprise. The authors substantiated the advantages of achieving strategic suitability: information technologies are guaranteed to help in increasing the value of products (services) and in increasing competitiveness and management efficiency. The article presents the dimensions of a structured approach to the strategic management formation process and planning of information systems in modern digital enterprises.

articleTitle: Optimal Solution to the Problem of Choosing Means to Minimize Information Security Risks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of solving the problem of the optimal choice of means to minimize information security risks of an automated information processing system. It is shown that this solution is based on the principle of a guaranteed result by the minimax criterion. The problem is reduced to solving an integer linear programming problem. The results of the numerical solution of this problem of choosing the means of minimizing information security risks are presented.

articleTitle: Application of an Optical Sensor for Fracture and Chips Control on Metal Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of using a reflectometric optical sensor to control cracks in metal reflective surfaces. The results of modeling the influence of crack sizes on the sensor's conversion function are given, as well as the results of experimental studies of the sensor layout. The influence of non-informative parameters on the conversion function is analyzed, and variants of the sensor structure, in which the influence of non-informative parameters is reduced, are proposed. It is concluded that optical sensors can be used to control cracks in reflective surfaces.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Quadrocopter Body Influence on the Root-Mean-Square Error of the Radio Waves Sources Direction-Finding by Means of On-Board Three-Element Circular Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: When creating mobile direction finding antenna arrays, developers have to solve many complex problems. One of the main issues is to analyze the influence of the object of the carrier of the mobile communication antenna on the direction finding characteristics of the antenna array. In the context of this study, the carrier is an unmanned aerial vehicle, on which a dipole three-element annular antenna array is installed. The unified electromagnetic waves diffraction theory on conductive objects was used for the calculation. Further in the study, a comparison was carried out using the root-mean-square error of the direction-finding, which was received by the method of phase correlation for various locations of the antenna array (in emptiness and on the carrier).

articleTitle: The Technology of Using the Information - Recommending System to Establish the Point of Contact of the Audience with the Product
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Many market areas use recommender systems. Based on the information about a customer, the system can recommend news, articles, concerts, shows, exhibitions, performances, videos, books, games, applications. The article dwells on the basic principles of using recommender systems. The paper presents a review of the main algorithm development: associative (content) rules, collaborative filtering, Singular value decomposition (SVD) and Alternating Least Squares (ALS) algorithms. The authors propose quality metrics, such as Prediction Accuracy for evaluating the prognosis accuracy, Decision support for evaluating the recommendation relevance, and Rank Accuracy - the ranking quality of recommendations issued. The authors took data on users' grocery shopping from 2017 to 2019 (1 million transactions) from one of the major online retailers to examine SVD and ALS algorithms. The computer program was designed in Python using scipy collections, statsmodels, surprise, sklearn, matplotlib, and included data pre-processing and clearing. As a result, it was found out that the ALS model was quicker than SVD when processing large data volumes. SVD is more favorable if the criterion is the accuracy of recommendations.

articleTitle: Application of Ultrasonic Method for Non-Contact Control of External Defects of Metal Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers a non-contact method of controlling external defects of metal surfaces. The differential method of processing information obtained by ultrasonic echo-method from different measuring channels is used. Mathematical modelling of offered method has demonstrated its practical application. The structure of intelligent measuring device was proposed, a schematic diagram was developed and a prototype of the sensor was assembled. Tests have proved possibility of determining of small defects of metal surfaces.

articleTitle: Full-Wave Rectification Based on Diode Bridge in NI ELVIS Complex
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A full-wave rectifier is considered as a nonlinear device, widely used in domestic electric appliances, in distribution networks, electric driven complexes and therefore useful for studying in the course of electrical engineering. The rectifier implementation in the form of a diode bridge and the results of its investigation with the aid of the control and measuring complex NI ELVIS are shown. The properties and characteristics of the rectifier are evaluated using the obtained signal spectra. The rectified signal was detected by means of a low-pass filter and the error of this filtering was estimated.

articleTitle: Development of an Algorithm for Automated Evaluation of the Operability of Structural Elements of Shut-off Valves
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The tightness and quality of the sealing connection of the shut-off valves is characterized by design and technological parameters. The variety of external factors acting on the seal entails a significant increase in the error of traditional methods for assessing the state of the structure, depending on the time of operation. To improve the accuracy of assessing the operability of the structures of locking devices, an algorithm for automated assessment of the reliability of sealing joints is proposed. The work also carried out a probabilistic assessment of the performance and predicting the reliability of critical elements of the connection of locking devices. The analysis of the effectiveness of the proposed solutions is carried out on the example of evaluating the performance of ball valves. The results of the research can be used to create systems for automated control and product quality management in the design and production processes.

Author Keywords: automated assessment of working capacity and safety

articleTitle: Information Technologies in Quality Management Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The goal of the research is to consider the methods of machine and artificial intelligence, and to give a conclusion about the applicability of the methods in quality management processes. Nowadays companies must adapt to new conditions to maintain the leadership of the industry constantly. The management of product quality and process efficiency becomes impossible without high computing power, using advanced technologies in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as specialists with extensive knowledge in related fields. As a result of the research, the methods were identified which allow us to evaluate the efficiency of QMS processes, to find areas for improving processes

articleTitle: Industrial Systems Security Assessments Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, when organizing the protection of industrial systems for various purposes, there are two extremes. The first extreme is the implementation of incompatible information security means that don't affect the IT framework. The second extreme is the implementation of various modes of total isolation (for example, the Zero Trust architecture). As follows from the annual analytical reports of world experts (IBM, MS, Group-IB, Positive Technology, etc.), there is a constant increase in messages about the closure of the critical vulnerabilities. At the same time, the problem of ensuring the safety of industrial systems has not been resolved. It is known that this problem is recognized by many experts as relevant and important. The presented work provides a brief overview of existing approaches to assessing the security of industrial systems. The formulated recommendations can be applied to improve existing and create innovative solutions to ensure the safety of industrial systems.

articleTitle: A Platform for Mixed Foreign Language Teaching at a University: Creation and Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The information-training environment (ITS) contributes to the improvement of forms and methods in the educational process. Such a system allows designing a holistic educational environment for teaching students, develop the educational process based on the principles of modularity, variability, interactivity and multimedia. Information systems for educational purposes make it possible for all students to simultaneously use the content, the possibility of multiple training of lexical and grammatical material, viewing video material out of class, providing educational material for working in individual and group interaction modes. ITS can be considered as a self-organizing system for managing the educational process, which enables to quickly monitor the students' independent work. Using information systems for teaching students in blended or distance learning enables to make the direct contact between the student and the teacher at all stages. The ITS provides an opportunity for a more in-depth development and increase in tasks volume performed by students.

articleTitle: Development of the Model of Digital Technology Stack for Promoting Accounts in the Field of Science and Education on Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Institute for Statistical Studies and Economics of Knowledge by National Research University — Higher School of Economics (HSE) in Data Book “Science Indicators: 2021”<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>Website of Higher School of Economics (HSE), https://lissek.hse.ru/news/454933528.html. “Science Indicators: 2021”, 29.03.2021. talks about 10 trends that characterize the current state of Russian science. One of the trends indicates a decrease in public interest in scientific research. Statistics confirm that a number of technologies used to popularize science in society are not enough. At the same time, the most popular communication tools in modern times are social media. The authors of this study analyze the effectiveness of existing social media models in the area of science and represented the complex of technologies and online tools required for setting up communications and popularizing scientific knowledge on social media platforms.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technologies and the Organization of Distance Learning in a Modern University (based on Materials from the Kabardino-Balkarian University)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main task of the study is to analyze the role and the level of the load that falls on the electronic information and educational environment of the university in conditions of distance learning format; to analyze the perception of KBGU students of distance learning format; to present an assessment of individual factors of the educational process implementation and used standard and additional communication technologies. In the course of the study methods of comparative, structural and system analysis, a survey of students of higher and secondary vocational education programs and teachers of KBGU were used. The study revealed new opportunities for academic cooperation; identified problems arising in the process of transition to a distance learning format, reserves and opportunities for further improvement of the learning process using information and communication technologies.

articleTitle: Application of the Digital Footprint in Teaching English to Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Using the empirical method of investigation the authors developed a professionally oriented course of English based on the didactic potential of digital technologies. The approach includes the stages of teaching the language in integration with various forms of interaction between subjects of the educational process through persistent chat-based collaboration platform and online services. The authors determined the structural and informative characteristics of the educational footprint as a way to organise individual educational paths in the developed course. Practical use of the research results contributes to the improvement of teaching English to students of technical specialities.

articleTitle: Improving the Control of the Automated Technological Environment to Improve the Efficiency of the Tool in Environments with a Glow Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The issues of improving the efficiency and quality of control of technological processes of hardening tools in the glow discharge are considered. On the basis of continuous control of technological parameters of the hardening process, effective control of the technological environment is provided. A modeling algorithm is proposed for creating an automated control and management system for the efficiency and quality of tool production. This made it possible to optimize its equipment for hardening a wide range of tools in plasma generators of a glow discharge by changing the nature of the plasma exposure and the duration. On the basis of continuous neural network monitoring of technological transitions, a given thermodynamic structure of the surface layer of the working parts of a wide range of tools is provided.

articleTitle: Regularities of Adaptation of Communication Didactic Processes to Modern Digital Information
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The modern educational process with included communication and information technologies has a number of pressing problems. Difficulties and threats in the work of the digital educational space determined the purpose and methods of research. The main tasks are the need to study the level of adaptation of communication educational processes to the content field of information security of the educational environment; research of risks and threats to the information infrastructure of an educational organization. As a result of the study, it is shown that most teachers lack basic professional knowledge and skills in the field of communication educational processes in the modern rapidly changing conditions of the digital educational process.

articleTitle: Ensuring Safety of Production Processes of Maintaining Forest-Park Territories in a Megalopolis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of improving the quality and safety of industrial activities for maintaining green spaces in the urban environment on the basis of automation tools and new technical solutions. The author analyzes the shortcomings of the common practice of servicing forest-park territories from the point of view of the quality of urban environment formation and ensuring the safety of industrial work. Methods of improving the quality of maintenance, safety and labor productivity with the help of new monitoring tools, design of technical equipment and the use of geoinformational technologies are considered. A system of hardware monitoring and formation of a fleet of production machines and equipment is being developed on the example of the production activity of the “Green Technologies” company. The methods and proposals to ensure the quality and safety of maintaining forest-park areas of the urban environment are being developed.

articleTitle: Using a One-dimensional Convolution Neural Network to Detect Atrial Fibrillation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes an electrocardiogram processing system that provides an automated search for signs of atrial fibrillation. It is shown that when solving such a problem, it is advisable to focus on the use of artificial intelligence technologies based on machine learning and neural networks. The analysis of the use of methodological approaches to machine learning and modeling of neural networks in the medical subject area is carried out. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network model was selected and used as the main tool for an automated system for processing electrocardiograms. An algorithm for detecting atrial fibrillation based on this model is described and the issues of assessing the quality of its work are considered. The results of a computational experiment with training the developed neural network model on 92956 electrocardiograms are presented.

articleTitle: Semantic Deformation of Professional Subject Area of Future Engineers in the Information Retrieval Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Advances in information technologies and changes in scientific, social and technical spheres have revealed new opportunities for the development of human society. These opportunities known as “Digital Economy” and “Industry 4.0” require significant changes in both content and process of university education. To prepare successful graduates educators should align themselves with the 4th industrial revolution featured by remote employment and transferring of human labor functions to cyber-physical systems with artificial intelligence components. As a result, the interaction of human intelligence and the formal systems is increasing; new human-machine interfaces and formal knowledge representation models appear. Therefore, there is a need to study information transformations during human-machine interaction. The paper describes the study of semantic transformation influence on subject area representation using professional multilingual search queries in general-purpose search engines and scientometric databases. By qualitative and quantitative analysis, some linguistic patterns were distinguished and data retrieval skills development guidelines were provided.

articleTitle: Classifications of Network Traffic Using Long Short-term Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, there is an active growth in malicious activity in the field of communications. Leakage of confidential information, disruption of various network devices, and a number of other network security issues are issues that need to be actively addressed. At the same time, the means of counteracting malicious activity must comply with modern technologies. Solving the problem of classifying network traffic is one of the ways to protect network devices and communications. This article describes the process of creating an LSTM (Long Short-term Memory) - based application and how to solve the indicated problem.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Electricity in Electrical Supply Networks of Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the method of assessing energy parameters, an algorithm and ways to improve the quality of electricity at industrial enterprises. An algorithm and a hardware structure of the system were developed to compensate for the reactive power of enterprises. The solution is based on mathematical methods and algorithms used to analyze the harmonic components of electrical signals and calculate the coefficient of expansion of networks parameters when assessing the quality of electricity supplied to consumers. For an objective assessment of the electricity quality, all the data obtained were compared with the reference values set in GOST R54149-2010. The quality of electricity was assessed. This development makes it possible to set up electrical energy parameters, verify data, determine the impact on the network, analyze the quality of electrical energy, and restore electrical signals by connecting compensation devices. The efficient system makes it possible to analyze the state of the network and affect it. In addition, the algorithm provides an opportunity to interact with technicians in making interacting decisions.

articleTitle: The Role of Industry Electronic Dictionaries in the Process of Teaching University Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Dictionaries are always the most important source of knowledge about the language and about the world, since they implement the cumulative function of the language. In connection with the development of information technology, the type of dictionaries is also changing. They are increasingly moving to electronic formats. This is due to both new advantages and some difficulties in their compilation and use. In this regard, several tasks arise in the field of education: first, the need to describe high-quality vocabulary-type resources; secondly, to identify the existing gaps in this area and outline ways to fill them; thirdly, to include training in the use of electronic dictionaries in professional activities in the training of specialists. The authors of the article research these problems and propose ways to solve them in training future specialists in the field of railway transport, using the experience of pedagogical and publishing activities.

articleTitle: Online Course on Soft Skills for Global Engineers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Soft skills in engineering jobs are critical to success as 21st century engineers live in a «global village», work in international teams and communicate with colleagues from different countries. Moreover, engineers have to present their projects in a clear way to raise money and to disseminate the results of their work. The authors describe the structure and content of an online course on soft skills for future engineers and provide the results of its piloting of 2020/2021 academic year. The feedback survey of 24 Bachelor students of engineering specialties show that the students have significantly improved their speaking and writing skills, have mastered different formats of presenting information and have raised their awareness in cross-cultural communication. The findings can be useful to design and customize online courses in soft skills for future engineers studying at corporate and tertiary education universities.

articleTitle: Electronic Engineering English Course for Master's Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes Electronic Engineering English course for master's students. The approach of the course includes the support and activity of forming competencies. It is a universal function for solving professional and research problems of the future electronic engineers' successful professional activity.

articleTitle: Integrated Management Systems for Digital Technology Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents methodological and practical aspects of the process of creating modern highly adaptive information systems and technologies for the effective management of a digital technology enterprise, taking into account the requirements of the digital economy, aimed at meeting public and individual needs, allowing to increase the efficiency of business processes. The authors propose an approach to the development of effective information and communication technologies, which assumes the complexity and integration of system, strategic, information and objective-oriented approaches, which will allow us to successfully model organizational structures in the form of systems of objects and build dynamically developing structures. The article examines the organizational principles of information technology system establishment. A fundamentally new scheme of the information and communication system technologies of a digital enterprise functioning, based on integration processes in management activities, is presented.

articleTitle: The Risk Management in the Urbanized Territories Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the problems of risk management in the transport infrastructure in urbanized areas from the standpoint of ensuring transport and industrial safety. Based on the analysis of various risk management techniques, the authors of the article have developed a morphological model of risk management in the transport infrastructure in urbanized territories, introduced risk assessment indicators, criteria for matching the degree of risk to one or another safety level, depending on the values of the estimated indicators. A map of risk profiles in the transport infrastructure in urbanized territories is presented, on the basis of which a set of measures is proposed to minimize the impact of risk on various components of the activities of transport organizations.

articleTitle: Contactless Compact Through-joint Supply Voltage and Control Signals Transferring Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The increasing complexity of movement kinematics of the robotic arms leads to the emergence of problems associated with supply voltage and control signals transmission through the rotating joints. The existing methods for solving this technical problem can have considerable dimensions, lead to movement range reduction of the structural elements or have rubbing and wearing parts, which can increase mechanical resistance and leads to a shortage in resource as well as in the reliability of the unit. The proposed solution is based on the transferring of electrical energy between two inductors. It has no rubbing parts and applicable even for constantly rotating joints. In addition to the supply voltage, it also supports digital data bidirectional transmission. One of the features of the described solution is a possibility of coil integration into the hinge structure even closely to the aluminum structural elements, which does not lead to its significant enlargement.

articleTitle: Two Ways of Using Microsoft Sway to Teach English in Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the Russian University of Transport expertise in using the bright online service Microsoft Sway in teaching English in vocational education. The first of the two directions described is using Microsoft Sway for our new ESP online course “Management and Operation on Railway Transport” presenting where each unit exists as a separate Internet site. The new online ESP course structure and a model of interaction between a teacher and a student are presented. The second one is using Microsoft Sway for students' collaboration project. The example of students' project on the topic “Young Family: What Is It Like” is given. The stages of students game project work are described. Microsoft Sway presentations are easy to use and offer a new level of educational visibility.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Transport Mobility of the Population and Gravitational Modeling of Transport Movements in the Leningrad Region
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the author's methodology for assessing the indicators of transport mobility of the population in various territories in order to detect regularity, ranking and forecasting the mobility of the population. The methodology allows to define the interconnection of territories and infrastructure facilities in urban, transport and economic planning and engineering. There are presented the approbation results of the methodology by example of St. Petersburg and the Leningrad Region. During the approbation there were refuted the hypotheses of the dependence of the transport mobility of the population on the geographical, demographic, economic, social, transport and infrastructure characteristics of the territory and there was specified the dependence on the aggregative combination of these factors.

articleTitle: System-oriented Analysis and Classification of Process Control Methods for Software Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes classification systems for software development management methods applied in business processes. The project management process is aimed at improving the efficiency of management methods classification systems. The effective management method can solve project tasks and reduce the project cost. The process of management system software development should be in compliance with the IEEE requirements. The article aims to develop a system for classifying software development management methods and identify relationships between projects and project management methods.

articleTitle: Project-Based Learning as an Integrated Component of the Educational Process at Technical University
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The authors of the paper describe three stages of the technological process of implementing project-based learning into the educational process at technical universities. The main problems arising at the stage of integration and which make it difficult to create mobile groups for the introduction of a new teaching method into the educational process from structural units at different hierarchical levels of subordination are thoroughly examined. Some software products which are necessary for the implementation of project-based learning are considered in the paper. It is emphasized that without mastering the universal tools used for storing and processing data, students and university teachers will not be able to implement training projects.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies as the Basis of Teaching Special Training Courses at Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the actualization of the working programs of core disciplines, presents approaches to the construction of training courses. The research has shown that currently it is necessary to revise the content of work programs, to actively introduce digital technologies into the educational process. The practical significance of the research lies in the improvement and implementation of the teaching methodology for specialized disciplines using modern digital tools in the process of teaching students of the Russian State Agrarian University. The authors consider a practical example of using digital tools in such subjects as «Accounting reporting», «Technologies for working with information». Many sections of the program include digital tools that were tested by students in practical classes and in independent work in solving assigned tasks.

articleTitle: Visualization of Virtual Devices in the Design and Operation of Automation Systems and Tools
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of visualization of measurement channels of automated systems by developing virtual devices. Programs for emulators of such devices and algorithms for their operation using a high-level language have been developed. Virtual facilities are combined into a single measuring and computing complex with the ability to transfer information between them. The hardware and software tools of its functioning are considered and implemented.

articleTitle: Smart Service for Medical Care of the Region's Population
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article shows how remotely, using a convenient web service with an intuitive interface, it is possible to provide all patients attached to state polyclinics of the Voronezh region with the possibility of making an appointment with a selected doctor and canceling it, view test results, as well as statistics of visits to polyclinics by month. This will allow one to analyze periods of illness and be more attentive to the health in the future.

articleTitle: Mechatronic System for Testing Functional Characteristics of Heart Valve Prostheses
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The goal of this study is to provide a mechatronic system for evaluating the functional properties of heart valve prostheses. The system is made up of two subsystems (modules): one for determining hydrodynamic parameters, and another for expedited prosthetic durability testing. It is demonstrated how the first module data can be used to calculate the degree of hemolysis using mathematical modeling. The study discusses an electromechanical drive system, as well as electronic control, measurement, and video recording systems. The experimental results of system operation for checking mechanical and biological prostheses' functional features are reported.

articleTitle: Efficient Quality and Environmental Management of a Digital Transport Company
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main problem of transport companies is the imperfection of quality, environmental monitoring and pollution accounting systems. The article presents the goals and motives for the development and implementation of a corporate integrated quality management system at transport enterprises. Using the example of JSC “Russian Railways”, the authors analyzed the assessment of the quality of services and the components of services in the passenger transportation market for the period 2015–2019. The authors proposed the structure of a functional model for improving and developing the quality management system and environmental friendliness of a transport enterprise. The introduction of geographical information systems at transport enterprises, proposed in the article, will solve the problems of environmental protection and rational use of natural resources.

articleTitle: Models of the Envelope Probability Density for the Signal Reflected from an Extended Object
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article addresses the issues related to the analysis of the models of the probability density envelope of the signal reflected from extended objects.

Author Keywords: distribution of the envelope of the reflected signal

articleTitle: Digital Technologies as a Factor of Transport Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The transport industry is an economic activity that is affected by the processes of digitalization. The purpose of the article is to identify the features and trends in the development of digital technologies for the quality of transport services. Research objectives: analysis of trends in the development of transport in the context of digitalization; the main directions of strategic development of transport in the Russian Federation in the digital economy. The authors form the risks and advantages that arise during digitalization in the transport industry. A set of digital solutions has been formed to ensure the quality of transport services.

articleTitle: Architecture and Operation Algorithms of a General-Purpose Integrated Bilateral Manipulator System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article introduces an architecture and operation algorithms for a bilateral manipulator system (MS) with force feedback. Bilateral control systems allow a person to remotely grasp various objects and manipulate them, while also providing telepresence. A manipulator system model has been developed as a result of the work described in the article. It comprises a pair of robot arms and a pair of grippers. Force sensors are one of the main components of the system. Some of the sensors are located in the manipulator wrists, while the others - in the gripper fingers. This allows the system to transmit information on the position of the MS, as well as on the forces and torques of interaction with external objects in the bilateral control (BC) mode. The experiments carried out have indicated that it is possible to build a system on the basis of commercial industrial robots and use this system to perform various tasks related to object grasping and manipulation.

Author Keywords: dynamic properties of the BC system

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for the Game Mechanics Problem in Computer Games
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to develop algorithms and game mechanics for controlling the car driving along a track using a genetic algorithm for training a neural network with the ability to save and load the obtained weights during training. A genetic algorithm and a neural network were developed using the C ++ programming language without extraneous libraries. To find effective approaches and parameters of the genetic algorithm are experimentally tested and statistically analyzed some various of fitness function, selection methods and population sizes. Due to the results of experiments the final training is done. Moreover, comparison with the result of real player is made.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Privacy Information Management for Compliance with International Standard ISO 27701:2019
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: We are more connected than ever, bringing with it the joys, and risks, of our digital world. In the new context of the digital economy the Privacy Information Management is becoming an important aspect of business. The article explores determining of the Privacy Information Management processes in an organization: structure, composition and interactions according to standard ISO 27701:2019, the structure and composition of the Privacy Information Management documentation.

articleTitle: Applying Digital Filters to Suppress Noise in the Derivative Term of the PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: One of the most common problems arising in the implementation of a PID controller is the Derivative component, namely the influence of various noises on it. In this paper, we study the influence of various filters on the performance of the control loop. In particular, filters such as moving average, IIR filters, and a first-order low-pass filter are considered.

articleTitle: Automation of Matching Coordinate Systems of Manipulators with Different Spatial Positions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of using two or more manipulators together in the same work area is in different coordinate systems. The origin of the coordinate systems of these manipulators is located at different points of the working field. Commonly used calibration and reconciliation systems require operator presence and time. The developed method of automatic calibration is ensured by integrating an additional active calibration module into the control system. This ensures that the position of each manipulator is accurately determined, allowing the calculation of the transition matrix to accommodate different coordinate systems. The described automated method for coordinating coordinate systems can be used for portable manipulator systems that require adjustment after transportation or movement.

articleTitle: Active Control and Management of Vibrations of the Manipulator Positioning System Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the study of the nature of oscillatory processes arising in the construction of the manipulator positioning system (MPS), which, in turn, serves to carry out high precision technological processes produced under the control of the operator. The article presents a technique that makes it possible to determine the dependence of the oscillatory processes that cause an MPS in the structure on the forces of moments of inertia during finite displacements, including from any external impacts. The study of vibration characteristics was carried out on the basis of data obtained using an inertial system. The obtained dependencies make it possible to evaluate the nature and properties of the oscillatory process. Based on these results, an algorithm for the active control and control of oscillations of the MPS system was developed.

articleTitle: Review of Existing Blockchain-Based Insurance Solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of blockchain technology in the structure of various solutions for the insurance industry can make it more reliable and understandable for customers. Blockchain allows us to open up completely new opportunities in insurance and significantly modernize the industry. Many large companies and industry leaders are already using blockchain technology as part of their current business. It allows them to improve production processes, automate routine operations, and control supply chains and settlements with counterparties. This paper reviews existing insurance solutions with and without blockchain technology, examining their strengths and weaknesses. There was a review of existing insurance solutions: Medishares, Etherisc, PAL Network, Teambrella, VouchForMe, D3i, Insurwave, Dynamis and Consortium W3c.

articleTitle: System Analysis of Didactic Content in the Virtual Reality System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The demand for improving the quality of educational content in the virtual reality system is the most important factor in the process of higher education. The university education system is faced with the task of not just transferring knowledge, but also full immersion of the student in the field of an immersive educational environment. The need to create high-tech equipment for universities is justified by the graduation of creative-minded specialists. Quality assurance in the development of VR and AR equipment forms additional properties and criteria of educational content related to the transfer of non-verbal knowledge. Non-verbal knowledge reflects the emotional-sensory level of cognition and can be transmitted using augmented and virtual reality technologies. A model for assessing the quality of educational content in the process of functioning of the virtual reality system is proposed.

articleTitle: Classification of Network Traffic Using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the increasing complexity of DDoS attacks makes it difficult for modern security systems to track them. Machine learning techniques are increasingly being used in such systems as they are well established. However, a new problem arose: the creation of informative datasets. Generative adversarial networks can help create large, high-quality datasets for machine learning training. The article discusses the issue of using generative adversarial networks to generate new patterns of network attacks for the purpose of their further use in training.

articleTitle: Mathematical and Algorithmic Prevention of Biometric Data Leaks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Biometric methods are the most effective and accurate authentication methods. However, a significant drawback of such methods is the storage of authentication information in clear text. The article is devoted to solving this problem by means of symmetric encryption method and the method of dividing the memory space. The method of symmetric encryption ensures confidentiality during storage and transmission of biometric characteristics, the method of dividing the memory space provides an increase of information security level during processing of biometric characteristics.

articleTitle: The Use of Neural Network Models to Improve Software Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The software tools in mechanical engineering are distinguished by volume of data and algorithms for their processing. The purpose of the study is to reduce the software fails. Research methods - modeling, artificial neural networks. The new neural network models for automation of testing are proposed. Models are realized on the basis of the switching neural networks. The switching structure of neural networks allows you to modify, supplement, complicate tests, set and change the sequence of their execution.

articleTitle: Modification of the Algorithm for Orthogonalization of Geometric Structures to Optimize the Profile of the Stiffness Matrix when Solving Problems by the Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes a technique for constructing a modified algorithm for orthogonal hashing of topological structures. Its use is considered to optimize the resulting FEM stiffness matrix obtained in the CAE engineering system of strength analysis with a preprocessor. An example of the operation of the presented algorithm is given.

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratory Work “Pressure Measurement in a Closed-Loop Pneumatic System” in a Graphical Programming Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The report contains the results of the implementation of the virtual laboratory work “Pressure Measurement in a Closed-Loop Pneumatic System”. The use of this work is planned within the discipline “Measuring transducers” for distance learning. The purpose of the virtual laboratory work is to familiarize students with the tools used to measure excess pressure in a closed-loop pneumatic system.

articleTitle: Assessing Information Security in Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes a new method of assessing the security of critical information systems. To assess the degree of security, it is proposed to rank threats based on method “Analytic hierarchy process” (AHP) and to determine the risk factor of the totality of threats, taking into account the rank of threats to each specific telecommunications system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Quality of Teaching Students of the Institute of Informatics, Electronics and Robotics of Kabardino-Balkarian State University at Remote and Traditional Format
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyzes the progress of students of the Institute of Informatics, Electronics and Robotics using control charts on an alternative basis. Disciplines that are well adapted to remote technologies and disciplines to which such technologies are difficult to apply are identified. In addition, there were discovered disciplines in which low academic performance is of a systemic nature. Based on the findings, recommendations to improve the quality of education at the institute were made.

articleTitle: Analysis of the System of Legal Means of Licensing and Certification in the Field of Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In today's rapidly developing world, the issues of licensing and certification in the field of cybersecurity are becoming more and more acute. Regulation is not keeping pace with technological developments. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a regulatory framework that will be several steps ahead. Specialist certification and licensing of cybersecurity products is one of the most important methods of regulating new technologies. The article attempts to systematize the experience of various countries in the field of licensing and certification in the field of cybersecurity. This article discusses cybersecurity professional certification, cybersecurity software licensing, and lists reasons why certification and licensing are a necessity of today's world.

articleTitle: Remote Audit Improvement Methods in the System-oriented Information and Security Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes key audit and objective evidence collection requirements and remote auditing methods. ISO 19011: 2018, GOST R 57100-2016 / ISO / IEC / IEEE 42010: 2011 and IAF ID3: 2011 were used as guidelines. Foreign and Russian literature was reviewed, and observation methods were employed. The main opportunities for an audit risk analysis were identified, taking into account the information security requirements. The article aims to study information and communication technologies that are used to improve the remote audit method accounting for the international requirements and risks. The most optimal methods for conducting remote audits in compliance with the information security management requirements were chosen. Opportunities and risks for remote audits were identified.

articleTitle: Acoustic Emission Technique for Machine Parts Quality Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The existing methods of acoustic emission quality control under non-destructive static loading are not directly suitable for quality control of parts operating under variable loads that lead to fatigue damage. This paper proposes an approach to the development of a control system for such parts. At the stage of developing the system, the authors preceded fatigue tests with static loading with the registration of acoustic emission signals under both types of load. After recording the pulses accompanying the jumps of the fatigue crack, we searched for pulses with a similar signature on the signal recording made at the stage of static loading. Parts that were loaded with such pulses showed reduced fatigue life. On the basis of these data, a signal processing algorithm has been developed that makes it possible to reliably distinguish such pulses against the background of noise and interference. A quality control system for railway rolling stock parts has been developed and tested.

articleTitle: Neural Network Models for Russian Language Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Speaker recognition is a form of biometrics that treats a person's voice as a unique biological characteristic for identification, verification or speakers diarisation. Speech recognition usually used acoustic features of human speech. These acoustic patterns reflect both the anatomy and learned behavioral patterns of the individual. Present work has shown a performance of state of art approaches for speaker recognition on dataset of Russian voices. We have compared a performance of Time Delay Neural Network model based on Emphasized Channel Attention, Propagation, and Aggregation (ECAPA-TDNN) pre-trained on English data, model trained directly on Russian data and pre-trained model additionally trained on Russian data and model with some improvements in TDNN architecture.

articleTitle: Technical and Legal Principles of Information Security on the Example of Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the process of building new information interactions environments and using, creating information and communication technologies need interacting system of technical and legal principles of regulation that aimed at ensuring information security the state. In the article studied and analyzed this system. The following principles have been investigated: “digital equality”, “network neutrality”, “technological neutrality”, their connection and interaction. The article shows the existing gaps in the regulation of information security on the example of the Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Smart Solving the Problem of Optimal Allocation of Project Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Development of software package in the Java language, including a module for solving the problem of optimal resource allocation in the problem of project management under conditions of fuzzy uncertainty.

articleTitle: The Automatic Method to Recognize the Individual Characteristics in Brain Electrical Activity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main goal of the current study was to demonstrate an opportunity of recognize individual “portrait” in brain electricity activity. Proposed method was used special form of EEG numerical analysis, based on skeleton's modification of continious wavelet transformation (CWT). The proposed method was based on significant averagings in CWT-skeleton and required the recording of human brain activity for 30–40 minutes. Our study has shown that healthy person had got stabil personal EEG-characteristics (individual “portrait”), clearly distinguished from other subjects of the same age and gender group. This portrait was consistent over several months of observation. Apparently, this “portrait” was largely independent of the current emotional state in the generally healthy subject. The findings of this study have a number of important implications for future practice.

articleTitle: Determination of Quantitative Meanings of Informative Parameters in the Assessment of Walking Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is concerned with the issue of receiving informative parameter for walking technique assessment. The researches on this issue are necessary in the field of medical and sports rehabilitation, where such means for the degree of walking pattern recovery assessment are absent. The algorithm for the peak dispersion calculation for the phases of foot position is presented.

articleTitle: Role and Task Based Model Adaptation for Security Awareness Game
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article focuses on the model and the approach based on it development for calculating and creating quest type role-playing game which is used to increase the security awareness. Nowadays, gamification is a kind of empirical approach to education, especially in technical universities. The article proposed fills the lacks in the theoretical and methodological basis of quest games for technical specialties where complex equipment is used as objects of study. Senior students of bachelor's programme and junior students of a master's degree in the field of information security are the target audience of a developed game. The game's model and scheme based on the role and tasks are presented, examples of game tasks are shown. The main indicators for developed task's assesment were assigned. The main parameter modeled is the assessment of the task's performance in individual roles and the statistics of solving certain type of tasks. The substantiation of the presentation of the task as the basis for the role and task based model of the game environment is given. Experiments have shown that the use of predictive values obtained from modeling simplifies the design of tasks and games of this type.

articleTitle: The Neural Network Models in Mechanical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The goals of the investigation are to increase the quality of production and to reduce the cost of development and operation of automated control systems in machinery. Research methods - modeling and neural networks. The obtained results - new neural network models are proposed. Models are implemented on the basis of the neural networks. The switching structure of the neural networks was applied in the models. The switching structure of the neural networks allows to modify, complement and complicate models of equipment and technological processes

articleTitle: Identification of Time Series Models of Car Traffic Volume Fluctuations for Further Construction of Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: An unconventional approach is proposed for assessing the seasonal unevenness of car traffic, based on the construction of mathematical forecast models. The identification of the models of the time series of fluctuations in car traffic delivered at the junction points of the railways is carried out on the basis of a systematic approach with the ability to predict their volumes. The first step in the study of a series is to construct auto-correlation and partial autocorrelation functions. This methodology is based on the construction of the prediction model of traffic volumes handed over at the railway division points and moving further towards seaports with the subsequent construction of a mathematical model of cargo loading, on the basis of which it will subsequently be possible to predict the loading for the coming year. The proposed tools make it possible to develop prediction models to assess the seasonal unevenness of cargo loading in the direction of seaports. The graphs of time series and correlogram were obtained.

Author Keywords: time series of car traffic volumes

articleTitle: Intelligent Agent for the Formation of the Mature Infocommunication Infrastructure of a Digital Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The practice of digital transformations is associated with the tasks of providing a mature digital enterprise infrastructure. The digital enterprise is considered as a cyber-physical system that integrates technical and socioeconomic subsystems in its infrastructure. The IT service is seen as an intelligent information agent for building a mature infrastructure. Classification of digital maturity assessment models is given. Production model of corporate knowledge formalization for formation of mature information and communication infrastructure of digital enterprise is proposed.

articleTitle: Some Features of Online Teaching of Mathematical Disciplines for Engineering Specialties
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the methodology of online teaching of the discipline “Linear Algebra” to students of the Russian University of Transport. For effective teaching, it is recommended to use the Excel program and the basics of VBA programming language. Thus, the development of several competencies is achieved - the development of mathematical methods and the ability to apply algorithms and programs to solve technical problems.

articleTitle: Implementation of Machine Vision and Other Automated Systems to Ensure the Collection of Representative Statistics of Process Control and Quality Management at Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the evolution of the scientific basis and practical methods of quality assurance. It also analyzes the economic feasibility of machine vision and other automated measurement systems to ensure the collection of process monitoring statistical data and quality management at industrial enterprises. The main methodologies for organizing quality control at industrial enterprises are considered. The advantages of organizing quality control by introducing machine vision and an overview of alternative methods of using machine vision in various spheres and sectors of the economy are given.

articleTitle: SMART Technologies for Student Mobility in the Open Education System and their Application Criteria
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The publication presents the criteria for the application of Smart-technologies for student mobility in the system of open education. The novelty of the research is in the fact that the working prototype of the Smart-system for optimal decision-making, where students can independently choose the parameters and resources of the planned educational journey is developed as an integral IT-system with a single interface. The practical significance is in the fact that the system of open education is greatly enhanced by a unique possibility of organizing mobile education with justification of application criteria.

articleTitle: Information and Digital Culture for Future Engineers as a Factor of Socialization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of the article is to study the formation of information and digital culture for future engineers as a factor of socialization. The article is based on the analysis of documents and research on digital culture. The relevance of the problem under study is revealed. The content of the concept “information and digital culture” is determined, its definition is given. Methodological approaches are highlighted. The main ways of forming the information and digital culture of future engineers as a factor of socialization are determined. The main research method is the analysis of scientific works devoted to the information and digital culture of the individual, and digitalization of education. We defined the methods as a component of the structure of the model for the formation of the information and digital culture of future engineers. They are theoretical, empirical, technological, information-technological, reflexive. The design of methodological provisions is based on the principles of cybernetic, informational, activity-based and cultural approaches. Among the most effective technologies for educating the information-digital culture of future engineers there are technologies of moderation, deliberation, a pedagogical workshop, etc. The project method, modular technology belong to the list. The features of the professional activity of an engineer are revealed in the modern digital world. The presented technologies, methods, and techniques, allow to effectively carry out their stage-by-stage implementation and the formation of the information and digital culture of the future engineer. The upbringing of this culture is possible on the basis of innovative technologies, highlighted methods, and techniques. The information and digital culture of a future engineer is a systematic and consistent implementation of cultural values in a digital environment. This process requires the special methodology for organizing professional training of future specialists.

articleTitle: The Concept of a Distributed System for Vibration and Deformation Monitoring of the Railway Track Infrastructure and its Adjacent Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Present paper discusses the possibility of implementing a distributed system for monitoring the geomechanical state of the roadbed and the stress-strain state of structures adjacent to the railway track area, based on the integrated application of the latest achievements in inertial technologies, seismometry, and geophysics.

articleTitle: Online Learning as a Tool for Developing Learner Autonomy for Future Engineers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
