abstract: Current university educational context is vulnerable due to challenges caused by different force majeure, which result in dramatic shift towards online education. However, not all students are willing to deal with online edtech on a regular basis as they are under severe pressure from inability to work autonomously. It is an alarming trend especially for future engineers, as they are required to solve multi-dimensional tasks, be able to find solutions promptly and autonomously. To fill in the gap between the urge for autonomous learning and lack of willingness to study independently, the authors offer the results of the research conducted among 632 future engineers. The 2-stage survey via interviews and a questionnaire was aimed at identifying major challenges and benefits that can trigger sustained autonomous learning activity of students. The findings of this study can be useful for designing and developing online courses as a tool for enhancing student autonomy.

articleTitle: Search for Objects by an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle According to the Relief of the Earth's Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this work, on the basis of the theory of distinguishing statistical hypotheses, an algorithm for processing data on the relief of the earth's surface is synthesized when determining the coordinates of the trajectory of the movement of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the desired object. The characteristics of detection are calculated, according to which the requirements for the parameters of the system for determining the coordinates of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the target object are determined, depending on the accuracy of measuring heights when sensing the earth's surface.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Possibilities of Printing Multilayer Printed Circuit Boards on a Dragonfly 3D Printer with Expired Nanoink
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The innovative technology of additive manufacturing printing of multilayer PCB prototypes today allows complex designs of electronic devices to be printed on the DragonFly 2020 LDM 3D printer in a design center without traditional factory production. The technology uses only two materials, conductive nanoink based on 50% silver with a shelf life of 12 months and dielectric nanoink based on acrylate with a shelf life of 9 months. The article discusses the successful practical experience of using expired ink in printing. The design and technological aspects, possibilities and limitations of the non-documented procedure are presented.

articleTitle: Engineers Training for Digital Transformation of Space System Production Based on Information and Communication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern space technology manufacturing involves complex computer-aided design and production systems and the cooperation between many design and production enterprises. Instant information exchange between these enterprises at all stages of space technology development and production is a significant aspect of engineering collaboration. Such activities involve digital technologies of machinery design and information and communication technologies. Thus, the training of space engineers requires full-scale mastery of design and information and communication technologies. The article studies the initial experience of this task implementation through the collaboration of South Ural State University with enterprises to organize cooperative training of schoolchildren, students, scientists, teachers, and engineers. This collaboration involves universities, design, and production enterprises united under Ural Interregional Scientific and Educational Center in 2020. The analysis of this way of training confirms that the suggested approaches lead to encouraging results.

articleTitle: Using the SMART System for Organizing Mobile Routes in the Open Education System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The publication presents a prototype of Smart-system for student mobility in open education system and methodological recommendations for its use. For the first time developed a working prototype of Smart-system in the form of an integrated IT-environment with a unified interface for making optimal decisions when students independently choose the parameters and resources of the planned trip. The practical significance is the enrichment of online education platforms with a new functionality for the organization of educational travel (mobile education).

articleTitle: Creating a Simulation System of Orthopedic Insoles Based on Data from Three-Dimensional Scan of the Feet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes a software package for creating a spatial model of orthopedic insoles for patients of specialized orthopedic clinics. Methods of artificial intelligence and methods of processing input data used in the basic algorithm of the software complex are considered in detail. The features of working with various categories of three-dimensional images used for modeling insoles are considered, conclusions about the requirements for the quality and quantity of initial data are given. A series of experiments on modeling insoles based on the clinical data set were carried out and analyzed. The algorithm is based on the generative adversarial network (GAN) of the Pix2Pix architecture, modified by the authors. The software modules that implement the main functions of the software complex are described: the module for loading the initial data, the module for preparing and processing input data, the module for the main modeling kernel, and the module for visualizing the results. A 3D point cloud is used as a display format for input and output files. The goals and objectives for expanding the basic functionality of the software package have been analyzed and formulated.

articleTitle: Organization Methodology and Features of Building Metadata Visualization Services on Interactive Maps
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article provides an overview of methods for creating interactive maps with a convenient and flexible configuring user interface. On the other hand, also describing the method providing the fastest possible access to the required metadata to interact with the last ones. In addition, have been noted several technical aspects that require special attention when designing such web resources. The creation of interactive maps includes several stages: extraction, accumulation, and information visualizing. In general, this automation process can be characterized as research aimed at achieving specific goals. Based on the review and analysis, the author has been described and proposed tools and best practices were in implementing solutions, which make it possible to implement such a service-oriented architecture with minimal charges in terms of resources and save cost for ownership.

articleTitle: Data Quality and Standardization for Effective Use of Digital Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Functioning of a company is largely based on digital technologies that form digital platforms - a set of products that implements innovative business models based on modern technologies, new ways of interaction with clients, contractors and partners. The purpose of the paper is to form metrics of data quality when using digital platforms. Studies of data quality metrics in various types of business and digital ecosystems made it possible to form a data quality scale capable of assessing the effectiveness of the role model, competency profiles of participants in digital ecosystems, and the sufficiency of resources. It is also necessary to evaluate the simplicity, efficiency and discipline of data quality control and management processes in order to eliminate the loss of digital trust of users. The paper focuses on the organizational model of data quality management based on the quality metrics system.

articleTitle: Influence of Distance Learning Technologies on the Quality of the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the actual issue of the use of distance learning technologies in the educational process. The article describes the features and problems that arise when planning, conducting, monitoring and improving the quality of the learning process. The problems of communication interaction between the teacher and students are investigated. The measures aimed at improving the quality of the educational process in the application of distance learning technologies are proposed.

articleTitle: Challenges to the Assessment System of the Research Activities Management in Universities and Scientific Organizations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study of modern and innovative approaches to assessing the management of research activities in universities and scientific organizations. The factors that ensure the effectiveness of the management of research activities are systematized and classified. The positive practices of integrating key performance factors into qualitative and quantitative indicators, which are the basis of the evaluation system, are summarized. Since at the moment there are no authoritative and systematic studies that comprehensively respond to this request, we attempt to formulate solutions aimed at increasing organizational flexibility and convergence of the infrastructure of the profile organization. As such a solution, proposals are presented on the structure, as well as on the requirements for the tool base and IT architecture, in which the necessary parameters that characterize the work with data on the processes and results of research activities based on universities and scientific organizations will be met.

articleTitle: IT-based E-learning Environment Design in Web Engineering for Students: on the Experience of Regional Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study verifies the efficiency effect of the concept of an E-learning environment for students, future web engineers. Modular learning derived from the following integrated components stands for the concept. They are VK social media platform used as an information hub; an automated test system for solving problems in Steach.space learning resource; Zoom Video Communications to give lectures and consult students and Google Forms service for developing test activities. A YouTube video hosting service is used to store the history of lectures and consultations combined as F.A.Q. The training assumes the methodology of gradual complication of tasks, their hands-on focus, and an individual path of student learning. The scientific research aimed at testing the efficiency effect was carried out in the regional universities in Russia and Kyrgyzstan (Sholom-Aleichem Priamursky State University, Osh State University, Southern Federal University, and Pacific National University) in the 2020-2021 academic year. Two groups of students took part in the study. The control group (146 students) took the course using social media to interact with a lecturer on all issues, including turning in paper projects. The experimental group (152 students) took advantage of the designed E-learning environment in education. The research findings proved the efficiency of the technique used: the control group improved it by 22 percent, and the participants from the experimental group improved it by 42 percent. There was an appreciable increase seen in the low-level students' academic progress when performing the assignments. Further teaching method improvement can be caused by optimizing the design of system elements to reduce an educator's work while arranging the courses.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of the Face Image from Speech Recording: a Neural Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Human speech can contain information about the personality, gender, emotional state of the speaker. In this article, we will explore the possibility of reconstructing an image of a human face from a recording of his voice. To achieve this goal, we design an autoencoder neural network and train it using data from AVSpeech, a dataset that contains videos of people talking, collected from the popular video hosting YouTube. To train the neural network, we select short pieces of audio containing speech and save a frame with the face of the corresponding person. The audio data is converted into a spectrogram, and images with human faces are cropped and normalized from the saved frames. Based on the data obtained, we train an autoencoder network using a self-supervised learning approach.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Mechatronic Systems Based on Optimization Principles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A method of increasing the efficiency of various robotic and mechatronic systems based on the method of analysis and optimization synthesis is presented. The proposed method is implemented by the example of improving the efficiency of the functioning of individual components that are part of various mechatronic systems. In particular, the article presents the results of modeling the magnetic field of an electric motor using the finite element analysis program FEMM. Maintaining a high efficiency of the electric motor in an extended range of rotation speeds is ensured by turning the rotor magnets and introducing an angle of advance of the current supply to the stator windings.

articleTitle: Development of a System for Automated Control of the Process of Manufacturing Products by the Method of Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: High-tech manufacturing enterprises are faced with the issue of increasing the economic efficiency of the production of parts carried out using additive production technologies. A low level of serial repeatability leads to a low value of economic complex indicators of the quality of the final product and the production process. The solution of the task of automating product production control using additive technologies will significantly reduce the production time, material consumption for production, eliminate the need for human control over the production process and reduce production costs. The shape deviation values of the resulting parts. The article presents the method of application of automation tools of the most important stages of production cycles of production of products by additive method of production in order to increase indicators of repeatability of parameters of products and cost of technological stage of production.

articleTitle: Applicability of Quality Metrics and New Approaches to the PDCA Cycle in Improving Quality Control and Management Systems Applied in Aircraft Manufacturing Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Digital control and information security technologies are used in modern technological processes. Integrated control tools designed to make correct decisions based on the electronic models should be used in the development of technological systems. The problems of interface quality assurance are due to complex metrics measurement and analysis processes. An increase in the number and duration of management time delays and mismanagement of large volumes of data increase the number of errors and test time and deteriorate the productivity of software tools used for determining the applicability of quality metrics. The article describes the process of improvement of technological parameters and characteristics by improving the Deming PDCA quality management cycle and software interfaces. It describes the role of risk accounting in the elimination of inconsistencies in the systems and processes.

articleTitle: Integration of Modern Technologies into the Quality Management System of the Town-forming Organization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article contains the methodological and practical foundations of digitalization and the introduction of modern digital technologies into the quality management system of the town-forming organizations. In the article, the authors highlight the features of the development of a town-forming organization in the context of digital transformation, analyze the general system of strategic management and the quality management system of the town-forming organization. The paper substantiates the need to integrate modern technologies into the quality management system in a sustainable development environment, since the basic principles of sustainable development are based on continuous improvement and customer orientation, which are fundamental and correlate with the requirements of international quality management standards. The article analyzes modern technologies that improve manageability, competitiveness, product quality, reduce costs and form a more customer-oriented organization.

articleTitle: The Influence of New Means of Communication on the Translation of Scientific Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the influence of new means of communication, and especially the Internet, on the translation of scientific knowledge. It is emphasized that with the introduction of a new means of communication to the fore, the former ones are not “abolished”, but go into the background and acquire other characteristics. Under the influence of the Internet, a virtual (network) means of communication is formed, which is a dialectical synthesis of oral and written means of communication, giving them new functional characteristics.

articleTitle: Process Approach to the Management of the Ambulance Dispatcher Service
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the substantiation of ways to improve the work of emergency medical care in the context of the spread of coronavirus. The pandemic has increased the burden on the ambulance service, with the number of departures handled by one team increasing to 25 or more per day, compared to 11 in previous years. The average call waiting time and patient hospitalization time have significantly increased. This leads to a decrease in the level of customer satisfaction with the quality of medical services. The key process and point of application of efforts to reorganize the work of the emergency medical care in this situation is the activity of the dispatching service. Improving the dispatch service required building and analyzing a process model and decomposing it into three main sub-processes: resource planning, call handling, analysis, and reporting. The use of a process approach to the organization of emergency services allowed to reengineer and automate the activities of the dispatch service, to achieve coordination of the actions of the departments of medical organizations, to systematize information flows, to create a basis for the development and implementation of a set of measures to improve the quality of customer service.

articleTitle: Technological Safety of a Passenger Car. Ensuring Reliable Maintenance of the Main Components and Elements of a Passenger Car During Its Operation Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this work the role of the center sill in ensuring the technological safety of the passenger car is revealed. The reasons for its failure during the operation of the car are established. The methods of minimizing the influence of the established causes on the durability of the center sill and on the increase of the operation period of the passenger car are obtained.

articleTitle: Blockchain System Prototype for the Tasks of Metallurgical and Machine-Building Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Blockchain technology is increasingly being applied in various fields. The correct use of this technology makes it possible to ensure the transparency of transactions, accounting of goods at enterprises, the truthful issuance of diplomas, and much more. Industry and metallurgy have become one of the new areas of application of blockchain technology. Exploring the applicability of blockchain technology in this area and then creating new systems will help improve processes in industry and metallurgy. The article discusses the prospect of using blockchain technology in metallurgical and industrial enterprises, and also provides an overview of the real application in real enterprises. A model using blockchain technology for such enterprises is presented.

articleTitle: Distant Tour of All-Russian Academic Competition in Foreign Languages as a Tool of Determining the Formation of Communicative Competence among Students of Engineering Specialities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reports on the experience of preparing, conducting and the results of the distance tour of the All-Russian Students' Academic Competition in Foreign Languages “Prometheus”. The event is held at the MOOC platform with the participation of the Institute of Distance Education, South Ural State University. The authors analyze the positive trends in the development of the on-line round of the academic competition, level of communicative competence's formation, and they also characterize the largest group of the participants, namely students of engineering specialties.

articleTitle: Methods for Determining the Interface Boundary During Material Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, one of the urgent tasks of the industry is to improve the quality of processing of heterogeneous materials, which is caused both by the proliferation of new materials, including composite materials, and by the expansion of the scope of application of already existing types of processing for various tasks. One of the possible ways to improve the quality of technological processes for inhomogeneous materials is the detection of interphase boundaries directly during processing, which provides ample opportunities for adjusting processing parameters to maintain the quality of a technological operation under conditions of a variable material response. The article provides a classification of existing technologies for detecting interphase boundaries, considers the physical principles of operation, on the basis of which the advantages and disadvantages of specific technologies are formulated. Based on the review, a technique for detecting interphase boundaries is formulated, the development and implementation of which is of interest for further research.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Text Content Quality of a Distance Technical Translation Course for Graduate Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study examines approaches for evaluating text content in a distance learning course using texts from a course on technical translation for graduate students as an example. The research was carried out in two stages. At the first stage, a comparative analysis of existing programs for automated assessment of text quality was carried out. The main criteria underlying the operation of these software tools, their advantages and limitations in use have been determined. At the second stage, additional criteria are developed that are applicable to the assessment of the text in the course of technical translation. Using the method of expert assessments, the ranking of additional assessment criteria was carried out.

articleTitle: Manipulative IT and Verbal Strategies in Scientific and Technical Advertising
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of manipulating the mass human consciousness by forming the necessary reactions to external stimuli in an individual is extremely relevant. Modern mass media act as an instrument of such influence, using appropriate language forms and means. These means include advertising scientific and technical texts that form behavioral models and attract potential customers. The subject of the research is manipulative IT- and speech strategies used in the creation of advertising scientific and technical texts which contain information about product properties in order to promote this product in the consumer market. The research methodology is based on a communicative-pragmatic approach, which uses a number of methods, including those of deductive, informational and contextual analysis. The authors conclude that among the most effective techniques of influencing the consumer audience are persuading and planting. The widespread use of information technologies contributes to the increase in the effectiveness of these techniques.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Learning by Programs of Bachelors and Masters Training for Machine-building Production
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the characteristics of digital machine-building production based on an integrated information environment based on PLM technologies. It is noted that the training of modern engineering personnel requires the implementation of the concept of digital production at the university. The experience of digitalization of training bachelors and masters for mechanical engineering is presented. It is emphasized that without active interaction with the main partner enterprises in personnel training, it is impossible to successfully implement the concept of digital production at the university and to solve the problems of teaching students the methods of collective work and project activities.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Employment Centers Based on the Concept of Lean Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: As a research goal of the article, the authors identified an attempt to develop and implement a unified approach to the implementation of the concept of digital lean production in the activities of a typical employment center. As a result, the advantages and difficulties of implementing the concept of digital Lean production in the activities of employment centers are identified. A model of a digital Lean office has been developed that takes into account the specifics of the functioning of employment centers. A unified practice-oriented approach to the implementation of the concept of digital Lean production is proposed, as the main set of measures to improve the quality levels and information support of the processes of providing services to the population and eliminating the resulting losses.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Decision Support Method for Control Systems of Technological Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The transition to new CNC equipment causes a need for a tool that would allow one to accumulate, store and present practice-proven and specially digitally prepared knowledge bases on the organization and implementation of the design processes of certain classes technological operations (in our case, these are parts of the turning and milling group). In addition, these tools should offer ready-to-use prescription level technological solutions, which can be repeatedly included in the operational technologies for parts of this class, with the consideration to the specified parameters of their manufacturing on CNC equipment.

articleTitle: The Objective Characteristics Estimation in the EEG Evoked Potentials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This study set out to numerical analysis of the cognitive evoked potentials in humans with headache complaints. It is well known that with chronic pain, cognitive functions are often disordered in one form or another. Evoked potentials (EP), estimated from the EEG when performing a special cognitive tests, make it possible to assess such mild impairments. Now there is a large complex of problems associated with the automatic extract of the EP frequency components and time features. The purpose of the current research was to determine solutions that allow effectively extract the time-dependent individual characteristics for different subjects. We demonstrate EP characteristics in patients groupes, correlated with different types of headaches.

articleTitle: Transformation of the Digital Environment into Actor of E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to show the changes in the digital environment of higher education that have taken place during the last 10 years. Analysis of e-learning practice showed that the digital environment has significantly transformed due to the emergence of new digital technologies and opportunities. Great changes are being observed in the creation and distribution of educational content, in interactions between students and lectures, and in the digital environment itself. The digital environment from the controlled object in the educational process acquires noticeable features of subjectivity, such as: it influences the choice of users and making of decisions during consuming content or performing actions. And lecturers and students are becoming a constant source of data for the digital environment which is collecting and processing their digital traces, thus feeding the spread of artificial intelligence in education with important resources - data.

articleTitle: Life Cycle of Products and Services in Digital Technology Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents the concept of the product life cycle for digital technology enterprises. We have considered the classical concept of the product life cycle, identifying its drawbacks in digital technology enterprises, using it as a basis for constructing a new concept of the life cycle, encompassing the creation, organization, digitalization and scaling of products. We classifying the existing methods and approaches and focusing on the relationship between the proposed product life cycle and technology life cycle. We have formulated the concept of the life cycle, which allows building a digital value chain focused on meeting the current and future needs of the customers with minimum time spent on production and an option for rapid scaling. The results of the study may serve as a theoretical basis for building an integrated management system controlling the development of existing products and production of new ones in digital technology enterprises

articleTitle: The Production Process as a Complex Cyber-Physical System of Relations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The modern production process is a complex cyber-physical system, consisting of interconnected devices for various purposes, designed to manufacture the required products. The creation of intelligent (smart, automated) production requires a deep understanding of the content of this process in order to study the composition and depth of the design and technological decisions that are necessary to build this type of production process. The article discusses the basic essence of the production process and its result - the manufactured product, in the general case, as a set of various types of relations. The interdependence of the relations between the product and the relations of the production process is noted, the type of these relations is specified. The functions that implement the corresponding relations are analyzed, the features of formalization and automation of the process of making design and technological decisions are noted.

Author Keywords: functions of an artificially created system

articleTitle: Features of Advanced Product Quality Planning in the Space Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article explores the application of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) in the space industry enterprises. In the modern context of growing competition, this method allows to improve product quality by reducing the variability of the technological process and reduce the production time by reducing the likelihood of defects. The application of the method increases transparency and stability of the processes. The key stages of the development and implementation of APQP, the differences between the method and the traditional launch of mass production, the advantages of application are considered.

articleTitle: A Graphical-User-Interface-Based System for Removal of ECG Data Measurement Noises Using Newton filters: New Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article presents the filtering results for the removal of ECG data measurement noises using Newton filters. In order to minimize the measurement error and introduced phase shifts by Newton filters, the results of uni-directional and bi-directional processing of ECG data are presented. Quantitative indicators were calculated that characterize the increase in the efficiency of processing and analysis of ECG data at uni-directional and bi-directional filtration. To substantiate the practical significance of the proposed Newton filters, a GUI-based system has been developed. GUI-based Newtonian filters system was implemented. The test results showed that Newton's filters implemented by the GUI system allow filtering out natural low-frequency and high-frequency noises and will improve the ECG data processing.

articleTitle: Construction of Distributed Enterprises in Pandemic and Post-Pandemic Periods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Approaches to building digital enterprises during the pandemic are discussed in the paper. The problems identified in the implementation of measures to counteract the pandemic new coronavirus infection in the field of digital transformation and the organization of remote mode of operation of various enterprises through remote information and technology services are formulated. Taking into account the experience gained after the end of the pandemic, many organizations consider it expedient to remain in remote work, which will increase the efficiency of production, strengthen the social orientation of production, involving in productive work people with disabilities, persons caring for family members and mothers raising pre-school and school-age children. Approaches to the creation of scientific-methodological, organizational, technical and technological bases of design and functioning of organization of such type are offered.

Author Keywords: IT strategy remote mode of operation

articleTitle: Development of a Cryptocurrency IoT wallet with Automatic Authentication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper studies a practical implementation of Internet of Things device personalization. The solution of this problem greatly contributes to the creation of a system of devices that exchange trusted data. A fundamental architecture for a new information system that implements crypto wallets with automatic authentication of IoT devices, is proposed. The architecture provides a secure method of wallet initiation on a device. Internet of Things poses significant restrictions on hardware and software. The main problems are ensuring communication between IoT devices, optimizing the energy consumption of devices and small processing power. Changes in existing libraries and program code were required to implement the IoT wallet. The presence of a wallet makes it possible for the device to buy or sell data for crypto coins, for example, temperature readings of a video feed. This will contribute to the emergence of a new economic model in which the data collected is sold, not the devices themselves. Where seller IoT device transfers impersonal data to the customer and other IoT device validates integrity of data that is transferred. Based on integrous of data and its relevance other IoT device rates the seller and data costs.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Models for the Formation of Contact Radio Interference under Deterministic and Random Mechanical Effects on the Contact Mechanical Joints of Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the aspects of applying the general theory of systems to the problems of ensuring electromagnetic compatibility in mobile radio communication complexes. To solve this problem, models were constructed for the formation of contact radio interference under deterministic and random mechanical effects on the contact mechanical connections of moving objects. The dependences of the amplitude of the modulus change and the phase amplitude of the total electric contact current transfer coefficient on the amplitude of this variable contact force were obtained. Contact interference refers to a class of interference created as a result of the influence of the electromagnetic field of a radio transmitter in the near zone on conducting mechanical contacts with a nonlinear and time-varying electrical resistance or on variable contacts that are repeat emitters (secondary emitters) of the electromagnetic field. When moving mobile communication nodes, the frequency division between transmitting and receiving radio devices is determined by the bandwidth affected by contact interference.

articleTitle: High-Tech Educational Environment as a Means of Personification in Engineering English Language Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Engineering activity is becoming more integrated, complex, and innovative. Foreign language communicative competence is one of the key competencies of future elite engineers at South Ural State University, along with profound engineering knowledge. The purpose of this article is to sum up the results of implementing advanced language training in the elite education zone of future engineers through creating a high-tech educational environment where students have constant access to connectivity. On-line courses design allows students to get access to a broad range of educational resources and tools that help build an individual path of independent study to develop their potential. The effectiveness has been revealed via an online questionnaire, testing, and project work. The use of E-learning technologies allows to implement continuous learning processes in different educational contexts and provide on-demand support to students that make learning self-directed, motivated, adaptive, and resourceful.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnostics of Early Stages of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Neural Network Modeling Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers an automated system for analyzing data on diabetes mellitus and forming recommendations for the observation and treatment of patients with pathologies and diseases in the early stages. The analysis of the main methods of diagnostics of diabetic retinopathy has been carried out. The analysis of the use of artificial intelligence technologies based on machine learning in the study of clinical data of patients with diabetic retinopathy has been carried out. A convolutional neural network model was selected and used as the main tool for the diabetes data analysis system. An algorithm for diagnosing diabetic retinopathy in the early stages of the disease based on this model is described, and issues of assessing its quality are considered. The testing procedure is described and the results of the neural network training process for the diagnosis of diabetic retinopathy in the early stages of the disease are shown.

articleTitle: Implementing E-Learning in the System of Engineering Students Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers implementing e-learning in engineering students' language training at the university. E-learning helps to complement traditional methods and ensure foreign engineering students' better learning results. But the implementation of e-learning is linked with difficulties educators and engineering students meet. The aim is to consider the use of e-learning in the professional engineering education. According to the purpose, we put into practice a needs analysis, questionnaire and interview. The results show that the majority understands the importance of e-learning for professional engineering education, but they are not acquainted with the types of e-learning. On the results basis, the authors implement e-learning in the foreign engineering students' language training, such as social networks, language learning platforms and the online course, “Methodical support to the textbook” Touchstone “(for engineers)”. The results reveal that e-learning improves language skills, promotes engineering students' integration into the educational process.

articleTitle: Online Course on Developing STEM Lecturers' Communication Competence for Training International Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: STEM lecturers' communication competence is an important part of their professional competence that includes three interconnected components: communicative, interactive and perceptive ones. Each component is represented by integrative skills that must be used in complex to achieve educational goals in training international students. However, STEM lecturers do not use the skills integrally. So, the purpose of the article is to introduce an online course to develop STEM lecturers' professional communication competence for training international students. To make an online course focused on STEM lecturers' weak points in professional communication, we specified them by a needs analysis, a questionnaire and an interview. The results of the research show that STEM lecturers want to learn more about peculiarities of intercultural communication and how to use them efficiently for training international students. These findings enabled us to present an online course “STEM lecturers' communication skills for training international students”.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Support for Engineering Students and Faculty Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Engineering education for the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century requires students to have a broader foundation experience for life-long success, to develop skills that can help them become competitive on the international market. Having surveyed 102 students with their majors in engineering and 87 members of academic staff we found out that the existing system of engineering education has several weaknesses. Some of the weaknesses are lack of effective student-faculty collaboration, lack of information resources for students on their scientific work, low level of English for taking part in research activities. To strengthen student-faculty cooperation we created an academic website on the Tilda platform that provides the basis for student-faculty collaborative activities that can ensure up-to-date information support, enhanced communication and efficient self-study management. The results of the feedback survey show the efficiency of the website use for student-faculty academic communication.

articleTitle: Enhancing Creative Problem-Solving Skills in Future Engineers through Technology-Mediated Collaborative Inquiry Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Creative problem-solving skills (CPSSs) have grown in importance owing to the increased role of engineering in addressing societal challenges. The broadening scope of engineering practice highlights the importance of creating a broad and balanced curriculum and course design to develop understanding of the interdisciplinary nature of engineering and enhance students' CPSSs. The paper constitutes a general description of the ESP course that has developed a coherent approach to fostering interdisciplinary mindset and CPSSs in future engineers. The course design relies on collaborative technology-mediated methodology, laying stress on investigative learning process and its strong links to domain-specific knowledge and expertise. The authors specify the suggested strategies and tools designed to support the processes of collaborative inquiry. The paper describes the benefits of implementing a technology-mediated collaborative inquiry learning approach to ESP teaching in engineering education and presents the findings on how the suggested framework can enrich the learning experiences of engineering students.

articleTitle: Automated Analysis of Big Data from Social Networks as a Way to Compile a Psychological Portrait of a Personality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The Internet contains huge volumes of information data, both structured and unstructured, including user data. The general availability of this kind of information makes it possible to use machine learning to determine the psychoemotional state of users. The article describes the main methods of processing and analyzing the data of Internet users, and also discusses possible approaches to compiling a psychological portrait of a person based on the analyzed information. Particular attention is paid to the prospect of using artificial intelligence to prevent the deviation of the mental state of users. A review of studies to identify the relationship between the characteristics of the user's personality and the nature of her activity in the social network is carried out. The problem of automatic extraction of cause-and-effect relationships from tests in natural language is considered.

articleTitle: Online Course as a Means of Mastering Professional Communicative Skills of Future Engineers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The urgent need for e-learning is on the increase nowadays. It has been caused by rapid digital economy and digital education development, COVID-19 pandemic challenges, and requirements of the Master's students, which were revealed in a preliminary study among 282 learners majoring in engineering. However, the academic curricular of most university educational programmes are not flexible enough to provide students with completely online university education. To balance the situation, the authors designed the online course for Masters of Engineering Science as a part of blended learning method to improve communicative competence and skills in their professional field, which is available on the educational platform of South Ural State University. The article analyzes the results of the implementation of career guidance content's course and a set of tasks to train theoretical and practical aspects of the major using the features of English/German for specific purposes discipline and e-learning.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Student Assessment Algorithm Based on Classification Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The didactic characteristics of the process of assessing students are analyzed in the article on the basis of the concept of learning outcomes and classification theory for the automation of assessment in e-learning and distance educational technologies. Approaches to establish the correspondence of the completed educational tasks to the learning outcomes with the distinction of variable learning tracks are grounded. The formulation of the problem of constructing a classification scheme and an estimation algorithm for use in artificial intelligence systems is presented. The conditions and limitations of the approach are identified.

articleTitle: Network Traffic and Ensemble Models in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, the number of network devices and communications is growing rapidly. At the same time, the number and quality of attacks against them is also constantly increasing. To protect devices from malicious activity, various threat detection tools are constantly being developed and improved. This article presents the development of an application for traffic classification based on ensemble machine learning methods. When implementing the application, two algorithms were used - Random Forest and AdaBoost. The accuracy of these algorithms when testing the application was 99.99% and 99.97%, respectively.

articleTitle: Fast-variable Processes Analysis Using Classical and Approximation Spectral Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A comparative analysis of the classical and approximation methods of spectral analysis of fast-variable processes in technical systems is carried out. It is shown that the approximation methods make it possible to substantially remove the contradiction between the requirements for spectrum smoothing and its frequency resolution. On practical examples of vibroacoustic signals, the effectiveness of approximation methods is shown. The Prony method was used to process the time series. The interactive frequency segmentation method and the direct identification method were used for approximation and frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Method for Selection of Cascade PLI Filter in Design of a Computerized ECG Signal Processing System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article presents the results of the study of cascade PLI filters to justify the selection damping coefficient in order to increase the noise resistance system and create a software complex for ECG signal processing. To justify the selection of this coefficient, it is proposed to apply the supervised machine learning method. Theoretically significant analytical dependences processing system indicators on the selection damping coefficient of cascade PLI filters are obtained. It was found that at low values of this coefficient, the selectivity of narrow-band cascade PLI filters improves, and the quality indicators of ECG signal processing increase. Based on the analysis characteristics synthesized cascade PLI filter and the analysis of the processing results, the damping value of system <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\xi=0.1$</tex> is justified and selected to create a software package. To confirm the practical significance of the improved processing approach, the performance software package, which combines the PLI filtration system, has been demonstrated. It is shown that the improved (developed) approach allows filtering natural power line interference with harmonics at frequencies of 50 Hz and 100 Hz and opens up new possibilities for ECG signal processing.

articleTitle: Automatic Equivalency Restoration after Software Patching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Inserting of the protection system against exploits code in a situation where the source code is unavailable requires restoring the correctness of the program after modification. The proposed methodology makes it possible to formulate a criterion for the equivalence of programs and implement an algorithm for program transforming while preserving the logic of its operation. The experimental results confirm the correctness of the proposed solutions.

articleTitle: Improvement of Communicative Professional-Oriented Foreign Language Competence of Research Engineers through an Online Course
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Globalization, spread of coronavirus infection, development of digital education and the academic needs of post-graduates have determined the creation and use of the author's online course for future research engineers. This online course is focused on the improvement of communicative professional-oriented foreign language competence. The course combines innovative pedagogical and methodological tools. It is structured taking into account modern requirements and guidelines of pedagogical design on the electronic educational platform Moodle at South Ural State University and is aimed at improving communication skills in the scientific community of engineers-researchers, at their participation in scientific conferences in the work of international research teams. The presented results of the conducted local ascertaining experiment, in which 102 graduate students took part, confirm the expediency of using blended learning in the educational process in graduate school, integrating an online course aimed at mastering the communicative professional-oriented foreign language competence of research engineers.
